Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. > Let's face it, the NFL halftime shows have not only sucked in recent years but have been hijacked by an insufferable parade of performative wokeness that reeks of globalism and societal engineering. It's become almost impossible to enjoy something as wholesome as football when you're constantly bombarded with lectures on race, gender confusion, and the latest grievances pushed by a select group of self-righteous leftists.
> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.1i9sG2LNkfieeLrgNLYr7UHUr1Mk-NsPYWddAQXvXKw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=188914477)
> In today's world, traditional American values are increasingly under siege, and the recent alternative Superbowl halftime show presented by Turning Point USA (TPUSA) emerged as a beacon of hope and symbol of pure Americana. It wasn't just another show; it was a rally cry to all Americans to reclaim their cultural narrative from the suffocating grip of globalist woke ideology. Despite the NFL being hellbent on pushing a message steeped in political correctness and immorality, TPUSA offered audiences a refreshing reminder of what it means to truly be American. Simply put, TPUSA's halftime show proudly celebrated America's Judeo-Christian heritage; the moral foundation upon which America was built.
>
> Let's break down why this matters. What did we actually see during the TPUSA halftime show? We, and the rest of the world that tuned in, witnessed American exceptionalism, a tribute to the nation's founding principles, and an unapologetic affirmation of faith and family on full display. The show resonated with patriots nationwide, and others across the globe who yearn for a return to the core principles that built our great countries.
>
> The NFL however, offered a cringe-worthy performance of Bad Bunny swathed in leftist ideology and a bad-mannered version of anti-American sentiment. The leagues attempt to showcase diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) during one of America's most anticipated events was simply another belly flopping attempt at lecturing the consciousness of America, and its people's lack of enlightenment.
>
> Turning Point on the other hand featured a celebration of love of country and spiritual revival. A bold display of patriotism, Judeo-Christian beliefs, and an unwavering commitment to preserving America's identity; and delivered what can only be construed as a love letter to a Godly America. The entire 31minutes was reminiscent of a time gone by, when cultural icons were people who inspired rather than divided.
>
> The Turning Point team had enough of the Marxist propaganda disguised as entertainment and decided to do something about it. The masses tuned out of the libtard fest by the millions and felt liberated when tuning onto the TPUSA alternative show. They cheered, they cried, they prayed, and they felt connected with their countrymen and women across this great land for the first time in years. TPUSA gave the people a space where they could bask in the spirit of religious authenticity and not be judged.
>
> You could almost hear the collective sigh of relief from those who opted out of the mainstream pablum, as they tuned into the alternative halftime show. Every viewer could feel the whisp of fresh air hitting them amidst the fog of political correctness. This was more than a sporting event's intermission show; this was a blatant rejection of the nationwide fundamentalist circus the NFL continues to callously encourage.
>
> On one side, we had the NFL's glittering display of woke ideology; a flaccid pandering to every trendy cause under the sun that's robbed competitive sports of its honorable essence. And on the other side, there stood Charlie Kirk's dream boldly brought to life, championing American Judeo-Christian values like a Saintly knight with a virtuous shield, ready to fend off the encroaching darkness of moral decay.
>
> The actual field of competition that day didn't take place on the gridiron; it took place within the souls of the American people. TPUSA didn't just broadcast a show; they sent out a lifeline to every freedom loving individual who refuses to be swept away by the dead sea of cultural Marxism. "Well done, my good and faithful servant," Charlie Kirk

Hi,
Pete Buttigieg here. I was just in New Hampshire, where one of the most important Senate races of 2026 is taking shape – and Democrats cannot afford to lose it.
**[Before I share more about why this race matters so much to me, I hope you’ll consider pitching in $5 to help elect Chris Pappas and protect this Senate seat.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260223_1.QgGZd8&refcode=em20260223-1&t=2&akid=5258%2E582294%2EfDVe60)**

I’ve seen firsthand how much that kind of leadership matters – especially in moments when our politics can feel divisive, exhausting, and cynical.
Chris Pappas represents the best of that kind of leadership.
I’ve worked with Chris to bring infrastructure resources to communities across New Hampshire. He listens closely, leads with integrity, and stays focused on getting results for the people he serves. That approach has defined his work in Congress, and it’s exactly what he would bring to the U.S. Senate.
Chris would also make history as the first out gay man elected to the U.S. Senate. But what matters most is that he’s running for the right reasons – to make life better for working families, protect our democracy, and bring seriousness and decency to the work ahead.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/51744a384d17/a-new-chapter-for-south-carolina-join-stephen-goldfinchs-campaign-for-attorney-general?e=c5659786d3)

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
# WELCOME TO THE TEAM!
---
| | ,
I’m excited to welcome you to the growing team supporting Stephen in his campaign for South Carolina Attorney General.
As an attorney, State Senator, and Chief of Military Justice in the National Guard, Stephen has taken on violent crime, fought government overreach, and pushed for commonsense reforms that put the rule of law first. Now, he’s ready to bring that same commitment, experience, and energy to the Attorney General’s office.
This campaign is about the safety of our families and communities and the future of our state. We believe South Carolinians deserve an Attorney General who will:
* Protect public safety and support law enforcement
* Stand up to federal overreach and defend our freedoms
* Fight human trafficking and protect children
* Hold criminals accountable while supporting victims
* Ensure fairness, transparency, and integrity in our justice system

In the weeks ahead, you’ll hear directly from Stephen about his vision, his priorities, and how you can be part of this important effort. Whether it’s volunteering, attending events, or simply staying informed, your voice matters and your support makes a real difference.
Thank you for taking the time to learn more and for being part of this movement. Together, we can build a safer, stronger South Carolina.
With gratitude,
Team Goldfinch
P.S. Stay tuned for upcoming announcements, campaign stops, and ways to help spread the word.
---
| |
# ENDORSEMENT CORNER
---
| | Thank you, Sheriff Rhyne, for your endorsement! It’s a true honor to have the support of Sheriff Bill Rhyne, a leader who works every day to keep Spartanburg County safe. I do not take the support of our law enforcement lightly. As your next Attorney General, I will always stand with our sheriffs and deputies, ensuring they have the resources, backing, and legal support they need to protect our communities.
Together, we will keep South Carolina safe.
---
|
---
| |
# ON THE TRAIL
---
| | Thank you to the Spartanburg County Republican Party for hosting a packed and patriotic event in celebration of Presidents’ Day and the 250th anniversary of our great nation. With more than 500 attendees, the energy in the room was incredible. We were grateful for the overwhelmingly positive response to our message and honored to win the straw poll by a wide margin.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| | It was great to spend time with the Chester County Republican Party this week talking about how important the Attorney General’s race is for the future of our state.

We want to give you an honest update about where this race stands, Peter.
**The Situation:** This race will be decided in 8 days, and we are over halfway through the early voting period — when the majority of ballots are expected to be cast. Polling has been all over the place, and people are turning out in record-breaking numbers. The truth is this race is unpredictable right now but the momentum is on our side.
**A Challenge:** A new billionaire-backed super PAC just swooped in to double down on attacks against James. Millions of dollars are suddenly being spent against our campaign, and the timing couldn’t be worse.
**Our Plan:** We need to respond. We need to scale up our outreach to the voters that will decide this race. We have to raise more resources than we expected to make sure we can keep our message in front of voters and help our volunteers knock more doors.
**Your Role:** This is a true people-powered movement. Unlike our opponents, we do not fund this campaign with corporate PAC money. Instead, the vast majority of what we raise comes from folks like you giving $5 and $10 at a time.

I’m going to be completely straight with you.

Early voting has already started here in Texas.

We’re now **paying for ad time.** We’re **funding turnout operations.** We’re **pushing digital, mail, and GOTV efforts** to make sure every America First voter shows up.

And I need to say something most campaigns won’t: **_$5 and $10 donations aren’t going to cover what this moment costs._**

_Keeping ads on the air isn’t cheap.
Turning out voters isn’t cheap.
Winning a primary this close to the finish line isn’t cheap._

[**If we’re going to finish strong, I need supporters who can step up at $50, $100, or even more RIGHT NOW.**](http://links.joshcortezfortexas.com/u/click?_t=4e6c34758c664bd584987e77d35da9c1&_m=6e70c4bf47a14cce9dfe60ca3d36e312&_e=vKCoiE873V6OAyIbYKI7iXdJ9FchTRamc44sY_8DH_DRifkkv2j3un_x-LNTO8DCFAXCzM-apqF7u0hwsgsckMNUfHutz17kMdSRg46kdOwprSqJcBmoAkGhHhIAAa7hMqOcIi4J2HWOu_FJxBQwGF7_3uyptsZ7GTfvQk1OEwG3hI6y0HrIpZAU1qbNn-GTWx6H31f5PVYEii-f5QyVaVUJxYA7fVh64KoE7gQ8qLCZ7R6eN50wX6eXcVNUAwiE7XOy9EMsJnAZokWmvYZMDjvfzvt6x1kgmlYksgEUGnZB2je33sNl1p_WXm0RRCNwy4TBadz1xFuFVzB1khT2z8k5oubjt6a7JkykVvwHRI-5vidd0ef7Lm-V-zqNfWTQJCMpPIlIwaZ_9DnDSEybLZyxTdr89AnhogIdlTxAT3r9RVOR7mL-Z5JqT8v9-3dDZNS5smrN5727RP18Qy_8mahOtHlEFZOPZcfHWAB0XGMUrHKjcsbneWXzXh8G3I95mol9zKUo7jx_pdF6Hvv288bCoDbVXXxmjNLOGRuy2j4uG7g_Qgyw1_YcsDi3wAl8Avl64p7T_8GXTPi9G7gtrivek2V9Rpubq0p7x2DvjNlCw6yGE-vCn3nBujBZO2Rxf6jh7zufb-CulWoGiq-fWbnAnEezmPPowS7Zx0uHneFbqKIJQjOOcuKIEkCGFNg9OcZlbhymgvaf1hLpINUrSo4TcGjCDw6YM8WT6GjAIo_bHoMZ_El3vzvzy40rHqyhQ46fKmtCB7QYPvYptkIl5w%3D%3D)

That’s the level it takes to lock in the next ad buy, keep our message on the air, fund turnout efforts through Election Day, and defend our America First campaign.

# [Liberal Hollywood legend flees California, claims it has nothing to do with wealth tax](https://substack.com/redirect/ae385160-66eb-4bc0-9338-1fdd0d191a60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Legendary filmmaker **[Steven Spielberg has relocated to New York City,](https://substack.com/redirect/ae385160-66eb-4bc0-9338-1fdd0d191a60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** officially becoming a resident on January 1, 2026, as California pushes a proposed one-time 5% wealth tax on residents worth $1 billion or more. His representative insists the long-planned move is solely to be closer to family, despite speculation linking it to the tax that could cost him hundreds of millions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae385160-66eb-4bc0-9338-1fdd0d191a60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Iconic Manhattan move** : Spielberg and wife Kate Capshaw settled into the prestigious San Remo co-op on Central Park West, home to past celebrity residents like Bono and Mick Jagger.
* **Business expansion** : On the same day as the residency change, Amblin Entertainment opened a new office in New York City, signaling deeper East Coast ties.
* **Tax proposal details** : The union-backed 5% one-time levy targets billionaires as of January 1, 2026, potentially costing Spielberg around $355 million based on his $7.1 billion net worth, payable over five years if approved in November.
* **Political fallout** : House Republicans seek to block the tax amid claims of $1 trillion in wealth fleeing California, fueling a national debate over taxing the ultra-rich.

# [Florida gets $4M of wealth migration AN HOUR as high-tax states spiral](https://substack.com/redirect/12b5c28d-408d-4d6d-81fd-7eb9bbce102e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Florida is attracting **[more than $4 million in wealth migration every hour](https://substack.com/redirect/12b5c28d-408d-4d6d-81fd-7eb9bbce102e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as high-tax states like New York, California and Illinois hemorrhage income at over $1 million hourly, Florida Chamber of Commerce CEO Mark Wilson warned, describing their escalating taxes as a "death spiral" fueling the Sunshine State's rise to the world's 15th-largest economy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/12b5c28d-408d-4d6d-81fd-7eb9bbce102e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Wealth inflow relentless** : More than $4 million in wealth crosses into Florida every hour, day and night, sustaining steady migration despite a drop in daily new residents from 1,000 to 500-600.
* **High-tax exodus accelerates** : States such as New York, Illinois, California and New Jersey lose over $1 million in income per hour due to rising income and property taxes that stifle innovation and opportunity.
* **Florida 's tax paradox thrives** : Tax revenues rise even as rates fall, driven by business relocations, investments and private-sector growth that shrinks the public sector while boosting jobs and economic diversification.
* **Global ambition surges** : Having surpassed Spain to rank as the 15th-largest economy worldwide, Florida targets a top-10 global spot by 2030 through population growth, poverty reduction and a pro-business climate attracting billionaires and enterprises.

* **Sharp Hedge Fund Retreat** : Aggregate Bitcoin ETF allocations among major hedge funds dropped 28% from Q3 to Q4 2025, per CF Benchmarks data, signaling rapid de-risking after last year's buildup.
* **Brevan Howard Sells Big** : Brevan Howard cut its BlackRock iShares Bitcoin Trust stake by about 86%, reducing from roughly $2.4 billion to $275 million in the fourth quarter.
* **Bitcoin Basis Trade Fades** : Popular arbitrage strategy of buying spot ETFs while shorting futures has seen yields shrink to around 4% from double-digits due to crowding and competition.
* **Market Momentum Shifts** : Bitcoin's decline alongside macro risks like tariffs has eroded its appeal as a hedge, prompting systematic position cuts following the October blow-off top.

# [Treasury sounds alarm on booming private credit risks](https://substack.com/redirect/46109d8a-2997-4cdb-8e62-6695b7882e99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent expressed concern Friday about **[the rapid growth of the $1.8 trillion private credit market,](https://substack.com/redirect/46109d8a-2997-4cdb-8e62-6695b7882e99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** vowing close monitoring to prevent risks from spilling into the regulated financial system and harming individual investors, amid scrutiny of firms like Blue Owl Capital.
* **Market Growth Scrutiny** : The $1.8 trillion private credit sector has expanded dramatically outside traditional banking, raising questions about its opacity and resilience after avoiding major crises so far.
* **Regulatory Spillover Fears** : Bessent emphasized protecting the regulated system from private credit issues, referencing past crises like subprime mortgages and noting Treasury's authority to investigate if needed.
* **Blue Owl Actions Highlighted** : Recent moves by Blue Owl Capital, including asset sales and limiting investor cash-outs in funds, have intensified market worries and contributed to stock declines in the sector.
* **Analyst Reassurance Offered** : Experts like Oppenheimer's Chris Kotowski downplay immediate credit quality deterioration, viewing certain transactions as market-realistic rather than signs of broader trouble.

Dear Fellow American,

Chicago Public Schools desperately needs qualified teachers. But school officials are choosing to discriminate against Christian student teachers rather than fill those vacancies.

The students at Moody Bible Institute are experiencing this discrimination firsthand.

Moody's students are barred from participating in Chicago Public School's student-teaching program. Not because they lack qualifications. Not because they lack passion for serving students. But because Moody exclusively hires staff who affirm and live out its biblical beliefs.

**In other words, Chicago Public Schools is punishing Moody students for attending a college that practices its faith.**

This is an attack on religious freedom--one of the foundational freedoms that has shaped our nation since its inception. Religious schools like Moody Bible Institute have the constitutional right to exclusively hire employees who share their faith and uphold their religious mission. Without this right, religious institutions would lose their very identity and purpose.

Moody's mission is clear: proclaim the gospel and equip people to be biblically grounded, practically trained, and to engage the world through gospel-centered living. For that mission to be credible, its faculty and staff must be unified in both belief and practice.

But when Moody requested a simple religious exemption acknowledging its constitutionally protected rights, the district refused.

**Instead, officials doubled down --effectively telling Moody students that their faith disqualifies them from serving Chicago's public school children.**

Alliance Defending Freedom is representing Moody Bible Institute in a federal lawsuit to challenge this discriminatory exclusion.

**Will you sign our Statement of Support for Moody Bible Institute and stand with them in this critical moment?
**
This isn't an isolated situation. We are watching this pattern repeat nationwide.

In Washington State, **Yakima Union Gospel Mission** serves thousands of homeless individuals every day--offering food, shelter, and the hope of Christ to locals who desperately need it. Yet the state is threatening the Mission because it only hires those who share its Christian beliefs. Now the Mission is in court seeking to protect its right to hire those who share and live out its faith.

Similarly, in Oregon, Youth 71Five Ministries is asking an appeals court to protect its right to receive public benefits without having to give up its right to employ those who share its faith. Youth 71Five Ministries serves at-risk youth, empowering them with the hope of the Gospel. It depends on a staff that shares its biblical beliefs. But officials stripped the ministry of its public funding for only hiring like-minded individuals who ensure that mission goes forward, violating its constitutional freedoms.

When ministries like Moody, Yakima Union Gospel Mission, and Youth 71Five Ministries stand up in court, they are not only protecting their own freedom. They are defending religious freedom and free expression for every American--Christian or not.

**But these battles come with real emotional and personal costs.** Leaders and staff can face hostility, intense public scrutiny, and even open threats. Stand alongside thousands of believers who are praying for Moody during these stressful times.

That's why your voice matters so deeply right now.

| | Peter,
Early voting is in full swing across Texas, and **only 4 days remain** to cast your ballot before it ends on Friday, February 27. Election Day is March 3, but the votes you and your neighbors make right now during early voting will decide who carries our conservative values to Washington.
This primary is competitive—every single Republican vote matters in shaping the future of our district.
---

| | I'm asking for your support today because [I**'ve proven I'm the fighter TX-21 needs**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d945fe3e42&e=4d3fe76c62):
* As former Chairman of the Federal Election Commission (appointed by President Trump), I stood alone defending election integrity and free speech when it counted most.
* I'm a trusted ally of President Trump from Day One—serving in both of his administrations, fighting in the trenches for America First policies.
* A lifelong defender of the unborn, I've earned the strong endorsement of **Texas Right to Life** for my unwavering pro-life record.
* As a husband and proud father of six, I live the family values we hold dear in Central Texas—values I've fought to protect in the culture war for decades.
* Grassroots conservatives across the district have [stepped up](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=1489792c54&e=4d3fe76c62): the **Fredericksburg Tea Party** , **Bulverde Spring Branch Conservative Republicans** , **Liberty In Action** , **Kendall County Conservative Key** , **Kerr County Republican Party** , **Grassroots America We The People** , and more.

We must secure our border, slash wasteful federal spending, restore fiscal responsibility, and put America First — without compromise.
The Hill Country deserves a proven conservative who won't back down in the D.C. swamp. That's why I'm humbly asking you to **vote early for**[**Trey Trainor**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=2042cf5199&e=4d3fe76c62)—and bring a friend, family member, or neighbor with you.
**Here's how to act now:**
* Find your early voting location (anywhere in your county): [**www.votetexas.gov**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=e18d6df9b5&e=4d3fe76c62)
* Polls are open extended hours this week—check your county for specifics.
* Bring your photo ID and vote in the Republican primary.

Your vote today helps send a strong, principled voice to Congress who will fight alongside President Trump to keep winning for Texas.
Thank you for your trust and support. Let's finish strong and win this primary for the values we share.
With gratitude and determination,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative for Congress – TX-21
**P.S.** Don't wait until March 3—early votes are already pouring in. Stand with me today and help secure our conservative future in TX-21!

name: Take Action [Voter Action Project]
subject: We need real-time postmarks
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
Due to a USPS change, most of the country’s mail dropped in a blue box or handed to a mail carrier on or before an election deadline is no longer guaranteed to receive a real-time postmark. In some cases, postmarks may not be applied for days. That delay can be the difference between a vote that counts and a vote that gets thrown out.
Postmarks are how election officials decide whether a ballot was mailed on time. When postmarks are delayed, ballots become vulnerable to rejection, legal challenges, and partisan games after Election Day. When mail processing is delayed, postmarks lag, and deadlines become murky for voters who tried to do everything right.
This creates a huge risk of opponents of voting rights pushing to discount ballots after the fact.
We must protect vote by mail! Add your name to send a direct message urging your members of Congress to demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
This change is the direct result of former Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s Regional Transportation Optimization (RTO) plan that quietly went into effect last year.
DeJoy spent years consolidating mail processing out of local communities and centralized it into massive regional hubs that can be hundreds of miles away, sometimes in another state. That means ballots dropped at neighborhood post offices or blue boxes in most of the country are no longer processed locally.
Rural voters and anyone who lives more than 50 miles from one of these mega processing centers are hit hardest – so, most of the country. Many of us rely on mail service for casting our votes, getting prescriptions, paying rent and mortgages, the list goes on. Seniors, veterans, and voters without easy access to in-person voting are especially at risk. Republicans and Democrats alike depend on timely postmarks to ensure their votes count.
The good news is that when it comes to the Postal Service, public pressure works! It worked when we forced DeJoy to pause processing plant consolidation chaos. It worked when Congress intervened to protect election mail in past cycles. It worked when we blocked Trump’s attempt to move the USPS under the control of the Commerce Department and when the administration floated the idea of firing the entire Board of Governors.
Demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks and protect vote by mail today! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Jack Schlossberg
subject: My grandfather, JFK
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021826_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021826_1]
Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.

Dear Defender,

I wanted to send you a friendly reminder about Tuesday’s (2/24) webinar on Representative Westerman’s (R-AR) dangerous bill, The Endangered Species Act Amendments Act of 2025 (H.R. 1897). Sign up here to let us know you’ll be attending! (https://support.defenders.org/s/4621516/38SyG9Xl)

This bill, which should more aptly be called “The Extinction Act,” passed out of the U.S. House of Representatives Committee on Natural Resources in December 2025 and is now ready to move to the House floor for a vote.

Defeating this legislation is a top priority for Defenders, and we need our most engaged advocates to join us at this critical time to deliver messages of opposition regarding The Extinction Act!

Join our webinar (https://support.defenders.org/s/4621517/38SyG9Xl) tomorrow to learn more about this terrible effort to gut the Endangered Species Act (ESA) and how urging your representative to oppose this bill can make a difference for the wildlife who are most in need of our help.

Here are the details:

What: Wildlife Defenders’ Briefing Webinar:

Opposing the ESA Amendments Act of 2025

When: Tuesday, February 24

Time: 7:00pmET/6:00pmCT/5:00pmMT/4:00pmPT

Register here – a zoom link will be sent to you (https://support.defenders.org/s/4621518/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4621519/38SyG9Xl)

We are facing a catastrophic extinction crisis as wildlife populations around the world are crashing at alarming rates. Rep. Westerman’s reckless attempt to remove some of the most important tools in the ESA would leave already threatened and endangered animals in even greater peril. More than ever, Defenders and our advocates must urge congressional support for the ESA, our most effective law for saving wildlife from extinction.

I hope you can join Defenders’ (https://support.defenders.org/s/4621520/38SyG9Xl) legislative experts virtually tomorrow, Tuesday, February 24, at 7:00pmET/6:00pmCT/5:00pmMT/4:00pmPT to learn more about The Extinction Act and how you can use your voice to defend wildlife!

Hope to see you tomorrow,

Caitlin Cattelino

Director of National Outreach

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

body:
The entire past year has been one hit after another for us. 40,000 VA staff have been forced out in one way or another, among them thousands of doctors, nurses, social workers, and claims processors.
#
Peter,
VoteVets is an organization of, by, and for Veterans. It’s not our lane to hit on every single issue because there are other organizations better positioned to do so. We are here to call BS when Trump acts like he’s done more for Veterans than anyone in history.
With the State of the Union tomorrow, that job gets a lot bigger.
Trump’s track record is up there with the worst of the worst. The entire past year has been one hit after another for us. 40,000 VA staff have been forced out in one way or another, among them thousands of doctors, nurses, social workers, and claims processors. VA facilities are severely understaffed, and Veterans are waiting longer on care — whether that’s seeing a doctor, reaching a counselor, or even getting the phone picked up.
7000 of us were killed in Afghanistan and Iraq, but more than 140,000 have taken their own lives since 2001. Think about that. Think about how many could have been prevented, or how many Veterans haven’t been able to get the care they needed over the last year. And then ask yourself: How many more Veterans are going to die because of Donald Trump?
Even one is too many, and that’s why we do this work. Just last week they tried to permanently change the way the VA assesses disability ratings and rip benefits from every future generation of Vets, but they backed off. They did it because Veterans raised hell — and VoteVets was at the front.
That’s why we get up every morning. Because if we don’t fight back for the people we served with, who will?
Doing that work successfully doesn’t come easy, or cheap. The largest source of donations we have is people like you who care enough to do something. And before Trump spews any more BS tomorrow night, we’re asking:
**[Please, make a donation to VoteVets. Anything you can afford. The amount isn’t as important as the donation itself, because these up fast when tons of people are chipping in.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-feb26.0dMHx3&refcode=em260223-1-120&t=1&akid=34961%2E3013755%2ESmbcu2)

America’s public health has been handed to anti-science extremists like RFK Jr. People who peddle conspiracy theories instead of facts. People who lie, deflect, and shrug when children die. People who have never treated a patient, run a health department, or followed the science when it mattered.
New reporting confirms that RFK Jr. wasn’t some innocent bystander before a deadly measles outbreak overseas — he was actively undermining trust in vaccines.
Then, when confronted, he lied about it.
As a scientist, I can tell you this without hesitation: vaccines save lives. Full stop.
They are one of the greatest achievements in modern medicine. And the idea that someone who spreads vaccine misinformation should have any power over public health is outrageous.
We are watching science be pushed aside in favor of ego, ideology, and conspiracy theories. And real people — especially children — pay the price.
That’s why I’m running. Because public health decisions should be made by people who respect evidence, understand medicine, and actually care about human lives.

Campaigns earn their way in by demonstrating strong fundraising, broad grassroots support, and a real path to victory. It doesn’t happen by accident. And it didn’t start in Washington. This recognition reflects the momentum supporters like you have built across Middle Tennessee from the ground up. Red to Blue follows grassroots strength. It doesn’t create it. clean_body: This race just got more competitive. We need to be ready. | | | | | Peter, We have exciting news to share. Chaz’s campaign has been officially named to the DCCC’s Red to Blue program. This designation is competitive and selective. Campaigns earn their way in by demonstrating strong fundraising, broad grassroots support, and a real path to victory. It doesn’t happen by accident. And it didn’t start in Washington. This recognition reflects the momentum supporters like you have built across Middle Tennessee from the ground up. Red to Blue follows grassroots strength. It doesn’t create it. Moments like this come with expectations. This race just became more competitive. The stakes are higher. The work ahead is faster, tougher, and more urgent. To win, we need the resources to organize across the entire 5th district, communicate early and often, and make sure Chaz’s message breaks through the noise. If you believe in what we’re building, now is the time to act. | | Your contribution right now will help us build on this momentum and prove that Middle Tennessee is ready for a representative who shows up, listens, and puts this community first. This campaign has always been driven by the people of this district, not party insiders. That hasn’t changed, and it never will. This is a meaningful milestone. Now we need to meet the moment together. Thank you for being part of this fight. Jasmine Singh Campaign Manager Chaz Molder for Congress | | ---|---|--- About Chaz Molder Chaz Molder is the Mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, serving since 2019 and re-elected in 2022. A Columbia native and graduate of the University of Tennessee and the University of Memphis Law School, he returned home to build a career in law and public service. Democracies can fall in a matter of months. But history shows there is a way to stop it from happening.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260223-5938-footer&t=1&akid=5938%2E420207%2Ea0_fC_)
Peter,
Democracies can fall in a matter of months. But history shows there is a way to stop it from happening, and it starts with everyday people taking action together.
That’s why I launched the Resistance Lab. Thousands of people across the country have already signed up and taken part in our grassroots trainings to learn how democracies erode, how movements around the world have fought back, and the tools we can use to resist right now. Our next training is a special _Boycott the Billionaires_ session focused on boycotts and strikes, exploring the powerful, game-changing strategies of shutting down authoritarianism to win real change.
**Today, I’m inviting you to join our next Resistance Lab: Boycott the Billionaires training on Sunday, March 8, at 11 am PT / 2 pm ET.[You can RSVP using this link!](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52905?utm_source=em20260223-5938&t=2&akid=5938%2E420207%2Ea0_fC_)**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52905?utm_source=em20260223-5938&t=3&akid=5938%2E420207%2Ea0_fC_)
**[RSVP Now](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52905?utm_source=em20260223-5938&t=4&akid=5938%2E420207%2Ea0_fC_)**
During this two-hour session, you will:
✅ Learn how authoritarian movements take control and what that looks like in the United States right now
✅ Deepen understanding of economic strikes and boycotts as a noncooperation tactic
✅ Brainstorm concrete actions to support immigrant communities and demand accountability
✅ Join breakout groups to start building local strategy and solidarity
Whether you’ve joined before or this is your first Resistance Lab, I would love to have you with us. If you’re ready to stand up, speak out, and fight back together, I hope you’ll join us on March 8 at 11 am PT / 2 pm ET. [**RSVP now to save your spot!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52905?utm_source=em20260223-5938&t=5&akid=5938%2E420207%2Ea0_fC_)

I hope to see you there!
— Pramila Jayapal

body:
This ain’t the same Party that it was when I first entered the big leagues.
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=08db6be9c2c74370be9f19b63c9190e6&_e=NZZzbLaj5XRh2OUxr90u1uIKv9fH178bi47VhTycZOEWxp5ohtLPu5GoJooNjfW2V2ui9x6aoCad77aWgQUT4_Gf3JmQRWtL73nZvP12uyBT9DF8Tzu9ogGwYKGfjYTHkVnu-QjZpn5t1jnGEVmvg6Hmq3IN0g_gInpz7_iJV3hLmDD-8Hlak_vfnkaSIOaiR97Y5cKfvQW9t6zNcwOgkBafFarfJNRCQAqkq0GRM2Aa0Uk1-3_-x4IXi8JysXv4BVSweGzHZdGdmxfGygbJ12Wkfi9H2Ee-ZenHN-oLk_B6p6w3U-y8326_9gj3J7Q_Hbi8EYAHIFET70IERHOv---4JQUJG3gMbzxo2yqhVSbq7b7TC65emIDzwN8ULuLCSYG32ytSr9NayFxU8Iu-8SaJhTgopkjf47mzjyeT_SJZt54DIS3CNL_quKYTqPuPCv8EFvTNlzW3IqVk7B3LPAJPkxOnjJg7iQreCvvjedBLIioS2OFA8P2ypw2agWpP0xOOF6pLsekjLQHbAbNFNKZ2QV7--MT2RkSzXtsZi2LXqqCiUFYzoVz-SzgZ985ZnvC3Avu-SrDDSE9ynAKz8Y9kml58zL-4R4FjrBDlRBdBTT0xiU4XZpe0w16a3CyPITxNuJufLpixOAiyzp5S-wKZgSpyCzKcHzN3XsigQkmRhMCn8f6VGznoyF5v_ysqCnYbHWViqCuEAyFu938hmAw7RnprScCGBGGKFSkWm-uRhK5E7ymUEdCtKOlHRuumySiJMEj9rtwv2aB0KuYAU6-F4pvsOAnvEFBoGMhJHjZwK3Jhy7h0iBtV6yjf7rZqmsY_5OSKVgSJtnpNF5XENsFuSzgausgIiTDAZhi5I6o%3D)The way these Democrats are acting up right now's got me madder than a wet hen in a tote sack.
This ain't the same Party that it was when I first entered the big leagues. It's become a paradise for Liberal hogwash and downright anti-American behavior.
Whether it's...

* Rioting in cities across America and burning Old Glory
* Storming ICE facilities, doxxing agents, and throwing sandwiches at law enforcement
* Having actual COMMUNISTS run some of our greatest cities

It sure seems like once you think the Democrats can't stoop any lower, they grab a shovel and prove you wrong... Guess they never heard the first rule of holes: if you're in one, STOP DIGGING.
_But let me tell you the God-honest truth. They have the money to do it and if we don 't get our act together, they just might put us in their place._
Right now, the Democrats have a well-oiled fundraising machine that is raking in the big bucks from its out-of-touch, elitist donors - 100 million bucks, to be exact.

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: There’s no better time to advocate for our communities
body:
We’re practicing self-love, community healing, and wellness. | | | Hey Peter, it’s Matias with United We Dream. Tomorrow, millions will tune in to the 2026 State of the Union. In moments like these, it’s easy to feel overwhelmed — but together, we can choose connection, care, and action. **Here are a few things our community is doing instead:**
* 🧑🍳Tuning in to Season 2 of Just Flavors! — a joyful immigrant cooking competition celebrating family recipes and the shared abundance immigrants bring to our communities.
* ✍️ Hosting letter-writing gatherings to send hope and human connection to people in detention.
* 🧡 Exploring our Resilience & Community Care Toolkit for restorative, community-based practices, and building collective power through art.

**Our members are gathering in powerful ways, and it reflects what your support makes possible: connection over isolation, care over fear, and community over division.** We know that in order to keep advocating for the rights and dignity of immigrants, it’s important that we practice self-love, community healing, and wellness. **On a day when millions will be watching, United We Dream will be taking action to ensure immigrant youth and their allies have access to community-centered care.** [**Peter, our work to make these resources available to all who need them depends on generous support from donors like you. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125980221/603528432/454992728?amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&refcode=email_022326_futurecongresswoman&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTU0OGYwNS1mNTEwLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P-TNFYjvk2py7YQYlDUbBjYnnecv2bos_wXVtwT15j0=) Let’s be real: Before I won my first election, not a lot of people looked at me and thought: _That’s a future Congresswoman._ My resume? It’s just a little different from everyone else in Washington. _The following story is based on a review of every mention of George Mitchell from the newly released Department of Justice files related to Jeffrey Epstein -- more than 3,000 pages of records. Maine Wire reporter Seamus Othot assisted with this story. _
U.S. Senate Majority Leader George Mitchell, Maine's most prominent living Democrat, was investigated by the FBI for sex trafficking allegations tied to Jeffrey Epstein, the notorious and enigmatic child sex trafficker, whom Mitchell called "a friend and a supporter."
Mitchell has previously acknowledged his relationship with Epstein, but in a public magazine interview he downplayed the relationship, describing the prolific Democratic donor as someone who "organized a fund-raiser for me once," according to court documents.
But the relationship went far deeper than that.
According to Epstein files released by the U.S. Department of Justice, as well as previously publicized court documents, Mitchell maintained a years-long relationship with the Tier 3 registered sex offender even after his heinous sex crimes had become public record.
The newly released documents show that the FBI briefly investigated allegations that one of Epstein's victims was instructed to have sex with Mitchell. But that investigation was shut down during President Barack Obama's second term under unclear circumstances.

However, the most interesting bit of information concerning Mitchell's relationship with Epstein might be a 2002 shipping manifest showing that Epstein sent a FedEx package to Mitchell just two weeks before Mitchell began his tenure as vice chair of the 9/11 Commission.
#### FBI Investigated Sexual Abuse Allegations
Virginia Roberts Giuffre, the most famous and now-deceased Epstein accuser, was the subject of a DOJ memo released in the Epstein files that details a salacious allegation Giuffre leveled against Mitchell.
Giuffre "was interviewed by the FBI" at the U.S. Consulate in Sydney, Australia, and "told the FBI the names of the men she was directed to have sex with," according to a DOJ email with the subject line "Preliminary Investigation of Additional Crimes of Jeffrey Epstein and Others."
Mitchell was among those names.
Giuffre told FBI agents in March 2011 that Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell "directed her to have sex with" Mitchell, according to the FBI memo.
The FBI agents provided Giuffre with "photos of prominent men in Epstein's orbit to help her identify" the alleged perpetrators, records show.
NBC News later confirmed Giuffre's FBI testimony in 2019, reporting that she identified "George Mitchell" among those she claimed to have been "directed to have sex with."
That FBI investigation was shut down in 2014, documents reveal, two years into the second term of former Democratic President Barack Obama.
An FBI agent told Giuffre "his head had been cut off above him" and that he "was instructed to stop investigating the Epstein case."
The agent's identity is redacted in the court filings.
That Mitchell was acquainted with Epstein, and that Epstein sought closer ties to Mitchell, has been a matter of public record for years. Mitchell is listed as a frequent flyer in the Epstein flight logs, and Epstein had multiple phone numbers for Mitchell in his address book.
The DOJ files only underscore the relationship between the two men.
Court testimony confirms Mitchell "flew on his plane," though specific flight dates and destinations are not provided. House staff at Epstein's properties confirmed Mitchell's visits but provided no details about activities during the visits, documents show.
Other newly released records show that Mitchell maintained ties with Epstein years after he was a convicted sex offender -- a pattern that has emerged with dozens of prominent American officials and wealthy business leaders.
The timeline raises questions about Mitchell's knowledge of Epstein's activities.
Epstein was investigated by Palm Beach police in 2005 for sexual abuse of minors.
He pleaded guilty to soliciting prostitution from a minor in 2008 and served 13 months in county jail under a bizarre and questionable arrangement.
Mitchell's documented relationship with Epstein spans 2002 through 2013 -- covering periods before, during, and after Epstein's legal troubles became public.
The FBI interviewed Giuffre about sexual abuse allegations involving Mitchell in March 2011.
Mitchell met with Epstein on Nov. 6, 2013 -- nearly two years after the FBI interviewed Giuffre about sexual abuse allegations.
"10:30am Appt w/Senator George Mitchell" appears on Epstein's calendar that day, according to DOJ documents.
The meeting was nearly rescheduled when Epstein's doctor wanted to schedule a medical exam at the same time. "Dr. Merrell would like you to come in...we would have to move Sen. George Mitchell."
Mitchell was 80 years old at the time of the meeting, working as a senior partner at DLA Piper law firm.
The relationship traces back to at least 2002.
That's when FedEx shipping records show a package delivered from "JEFFREY E EPSTEIN" to "SENATOR GEORGE MITCHELL" at his law firm, "VERNER, LIIPFERT, BERMIARD, MC," on Nov. 13, 2002.
Coincidentally, that package was sent just two weeks before Mitchell began serving as vice chair of the 9/11 Commission, a position he held from Nov. 27, 2002, to Dec. 11, 2002.

Seniors who worked their whole lives now worry about affording their prescriptions. Parents sitting at the kitchen table trying to make the math work to pay for their home, childcare, and groceries each month. I hear stories like this every single day. They’ve already spent over **$1 million,** and are preparing to do whatever it takes to win this seat.

[**We’ve won tough fights before, and we can do it again – but not without you, friend. Will we elect the exact same type of establishment Democrat that got us in this mess?
Or will we elect a bold progressive that's ready to fight tooth and nail against Trump's agenda and push for real change?

That's why I know that we can't afford to elect another "business as usual" politician to Congress.
We’re in a national emergency, and there’s no time for incrementalism or moderation.
We need Medicare for All, we need a Green New Deal, we need to tax billionaires, and we need to abolish ICE.
Any candidate who doesn't understand that is complicit in what’s happening.

After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

subject: My New Ad
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:
|
---
Peter, We just went up on TV with a new ad that sends a message Donald Trump, Stephen Miller, and Kristi Noem won’t want you to hear. Because the truth is simple: For every city they terrorize...
For every family they rip apart...
For every lawful asylum seeker they target...
There must be accountability. **Under oath before Congress, Kristi Noem admitted to me that ICE is deporting people who are here _legally_ — people with pending asylum cases who have not broken the law.** _That’s not just immoral. It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.
I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.
I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

clean_body: fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance. It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction. It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC. But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11. As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you. I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great. We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win. So now we're forced to rebuild. The Democrat Machine is ALREADY crushing us in fundraising, ALREADY outspending us in key races, and ALREADY building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections. At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable. So here's my final pitch to you: I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer. I'll do what it takes to win. Do you think you can help us get there? Whether it's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up: , you've probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point. If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it's to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That's why I'm partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win. Regardless, it's an honor to fight alongside you. ## Bobsled Moms Take the Podium
American bobsledders Elana Meyers Taylor, 41, and Kaillie Armbruster Humphries, 40, [won gold and bronze](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkTGu2zAQBU8jdWtQS1lUChVp1P20KYWluLQYk1yDpG0opw-cK_z-vQEG8_tr-6IQQ779osSLv_mtedkyv2vk1rhsVmyN7JKkSrbQi20UcYc8N1Q4gUJAvTkK8dzG3i2eGVn3vAzGDPOsJjP0x2J5n692ZKNmPWqPShuD2o87m2FAP_Vh-dAUosZBjThf6OrxqiZth2mmafbdqNiFJuXyR0JuB_t4yovLZZfUx-Vo7VE7_bPDtcO1PqS0ejnpEPkMOlwlnukR9trhagvTPeQbfCw7XKm0sEfucH1WqsCRMkHik0uFRmeUAuMA75AruEKJWthhl8TgiySwfITs4CbRQWJHEUKGJFmsWGhMKVFjuFOIMTAcz_Q4SuAP-c4VbJH8lwEHZfSkzI_L0VLsy-Ie78-hTqYb1S1RiP9F27cLvRb8FwAA___GV6r_) in women's monobob at the Milan Cortina Games last week, with their young kids watching from the finish line. Elana, a mother of [two special-needs children](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAQgJ9GOwwOimxBsY3d2XZLgzIIN_wY4Gh8-xtP7hvcapqZL_N9_1_LSznv4v5PBZRmN0s1aYl4FY-1Yl7WtBaPOqRQ1JrViatPSdv0XoACJxQIsEUr5-9laLU0iICsRdlPUy8E5VPfWsnYxsTI-R_BuUFcxTiwEXqmxwE2BGidfGgUgEFPBxCdGg2MlLO150JxYZqBonY15e4ruVgtGn-nE3O3pdB6aWs9SsP-NjA3MF_X1cV1S_4Oh9vKs9PA_Eg1MAfUypPLxejiTt6F_BhqzIUEvJ9R1e1TJvYdDpsdFlKsemo8F1uKJ8bqUvxgik6BVIs3ubKr2Gapj8t57wqfmoHuQTn_ebL-uu4p4TsAAP__VGeU1A), rallied in the final heat to capture her first-ever Olympic gold and tie Bonnie Blair for the most Winter Olympic medals by an American woman with six. Kaillie, just 20 months removed from giving birth, became the [first woman 40 or older to medal in Olympic bobsled](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0TGunTAQheHVQDcIjAFTUKS53UubEo3xGByNPVe28xC7j262kPpIv_Tp_PravzBwSOdPjLT50-_Vy57oLky1Ut6t2MLkosSCNuM3WRZxl_zZVa9m6BWocXcY-Nl16zZPpGhsaRuWZTCmn5ehvTbtp2F1mnAxejnscrh1RVysWVajqddt2D61XqlRDb1WpsPJq6mfRzvMBmfjG92TC1Vy91tCqhd5fuSbcndIbHm7an2XZvzRqFejXvd9d1c6P4rP3qhXwhokIe_lLbmWRr1OYQdeMhBjQoj0UC5Q8WHJoAe4Qyog_MR3OCBKEisWaqhMgBViYExwSK4hIZwY6dPEXMPBtM_20BMqAu-UhcmYGcw6OVjpmP0xKaeN764auc2be9-BOZR5aXR_Rgz8j1T_-4vvTf0NAAD__090oak). Together, the two Americans now own four of the six monobob medals ever awarded at the Olympics.
## 6-Year-Old Sells 100,000 Girl Scout Cookies
A 6-year-old Pittsburgh Girl Scout named Pim Neill has [sold over 100,000 boxes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdKzMwNpO4SIN3U2bEvlnDJMMzMqYXe3bR5tXuN0nfdI50vn9tXwFYjrWX2FHX9aytCLLga-TsTWsS5R4MuZd9jPEGp4YWSRvci2gwfQaehiXHIjfy9RlXxABxw79YO3gnDZ26DafrAU7xmTsoPM0how5FHQ_LJh8dw478h-aBhhh0BO4W7gXuGszxsG4YFxRk8ZMTertj9DRNiz8lifWW5K9Y7-19jjV-FPBrGCOVSJFxs-pYE4Xt6uigjnURok_a6XK_Znkan0S-Ut49hWT1Nw_aO8PJGYFc1d9fryImU5j1aTXPRD_V7Zvt3p6-BcAAP__1JCAmQ) of cookies this season, shattering every known record. Selling enough boxes to [earn a trip to Niagara Falls](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOpDAQheHTmKxadtkYJiDYhGw23RCZdrnxTEG1sKctbr_qvcLmT0-_vj-fy2fInI_H77DTlB5pqUmWg1phqpXOZZW1MMVd9hLWM7xoZZG4yc-CGj1oBLRLDJmvxXVxSkRItqPJDIMZR-0H021T1Kj7SJ586ns0Q7IUvBtNHHqkIX50eXq_aUSLRjscb6FP2GtvV-PH4MeknKaYq5y3L8lH3SjxJS86b3fZO562Wp9F2V8KZ4Vza-2Wwp1Wke_3QOFMpYYD3aBwfkqpReHs4aJwgnCEZ97hoMwMgVu4CsSTwk4RJEEhfvvAI58M5S4_Fe4i35kKtI0OKBtBCwW-FM7G-d444z5Gi1ZbrXDuzik-W2bOxQ_K6cceMv-rrv_N_ZrwbwAAAP__hnyU0A) with her parents. She blew past that mark weeks ago and hasn't slowed down.
## Britain's Top Cat Outlasts Six Prime Ministers
Britain's most powerful resident isn't a prime minister. [Larry the cat](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp_G3ojgGgMLQxdLHdKlQ0fr2lyS22KwgCby21fpK_zzJ3065_y6r3fkxPnxAw_y8RHXHsua6d0S9U513crWEoWjHA23ii_aUinhWf6uIMEICQKmNSCna9Vj8JEIaBrJK2uVc9JYNT49mlmGye1233En4ywGrUErHWe0qOXI_vMmASZQUoO74RxhlmbalHFoXBy0pMC91Nvvwrk_KaarvKje9nKMyT97P9swfRtgGWDBbf8YfLYBlu-5U83YuWRMAyxvrvSzl3oNsERKnEkkrPUSB9Y_TahZXIS1ia1yR85NnCVx5x2T6OUUapLKTWDlWH0435wSN2MHLR8HcvrP078c8uXhXwAAAP__tpKKLw) celebrated 15 years as Chief Mouser at 10 Downing Street last Sunday, having now served under six prime ministers. The 19-year-old tabby was adopted from a London shelter in 2011 and has become famous for [photo-bombing world leaders](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpSAUBOCnwQ4DR0S2oNjG7t92SwNyUDYoN3Cuxrff3E32Cf56ksk38_tr-XIpp3P75Q60cYsLxbKceLeMRFgXX3zLGI5yNOeru9DnUsJe3gsI0FwAh2EJLuVnUV2wERFw6NDKaZLGCD3JbrdmRdAOgvHRqzXGYCQ47UdQP-TkFXTJftoEwABSKDC9GyOMQg9eauO0iUwJDIlK7f-UdNKOMT_lwtqv5eiy3YlejQ0_GcwM5vu--0TXJ2Mwf8YwmP9zpWIwp5O_0krvio1nV-vDaUceyn2mc-ONKiLx1VHjcuQPutq4I34WLkVXbXjdKefU9MSU2A6X8j8Gffu_y8LfAAAA___cC4Vw) at Britain's most famous front door. His rodent-catching skills remain [up for debate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SpSAQhZ8Gs7ag8W8Dgk3M7qYbWo02yi6KBYyWbz91Zx5h8lPnnO_7-5pe5IM_1j-0s3Grm4qL08F3DlwKp8lGmwMve9wz2UQX2xDjssWPCSV2IBFQTwv58ExNtRjHjKwrNqrv1TDIrlfVZn4Rz1K3kq1CiVaiRE1zq91g0c5DW3nzbpOIGpVscKipddjKTlvVDdQNTjSSF19iqv9Ff5SNXXjixame414Fs5VyZqF_CxwFjvd91y7RMTM274DAkQ-BY_AXw5tN4Pi9p1o46YaTSooBAqX0QNkYZiqwU_qfQbXwMKUMVEBJWOJ9-GOFXBJzqZJZztuH4HPXi0auO_nwdan82OVl8DMAAP__oXSJVw), but his approval ratings aren't. A Cambridge professor noted that Larry's popularity easily outpaces any prime minister. As one photographer put it, Larry is very good at what he does best: lounging around.

body:

First things first, friend — I hope you’re safe and warm.

This storm is shaping up to be one of the worst we’ve seen in many years. As of 2:00 PM it looks like we even beat the record from the blizzard of ‘78!

I did my first round of shoveling this morning and if you’re doing the same, be careful not to overdo it. Take frequent breaks, stay hydrated, pace yourself and if you need help, ask! And please check in on neighbors who may need a hand.

**Now a few important reminders and resources:**

| 🚫 **Parking + Travel Ban**

The parking ban is in effect. The Governor has instituted a travel ban, so please do not attempt to drive right now. Both remain in effect until further notice. Parking is available for permit holders in designated lots: **https://www.providenceri.gov/public-works/snow-parking-program/**

**🔥 Warming Centers**

Information about warming centers can be found here:
**https://www.providenceri.gov/pema/warming-centers/**

**🏛 City Services**

City offices are closed (at least today). 311 is operating extended hours. If you need to report a non-emergency issue, call 311. In an emergency, always call 911 (not 311).

**🗑 Trash & Recycling**

Collection will be delayed until Wednesday. Please pull bins in and do not leave them blocking the street.

**⚡ Power Outages**

If you lose power, contact Rhode Island Energy at 855-743-1102. Always assume downed wires are live and keep your distance.

**❤️ Safety Tips**

Keep your generators outside and far from windows and doors. Avoid using ovens or grills to heat your home. If you are using a space heater, keep them 3 feet from walls and flammable items!
---

I’m so grateful to the plow drivers, public works crews, utility workers, and first responders who are out there in these conditions working to keep us safe.

Storms like this are hard — but they also remind me how strong Rhode Island communities are. We shovel each other’s sidewalks. We text to check in. We lend a hand when someone needs it.

If you have a non-emergency question, you can always reply here or reach out on social media! I’ll continue sharing updates on Facebook, Bluesky, and Instagram throughout the day.

We’ll get through this together. One shovel at a time.

With care,

Sue

And now, to show these left-wing thugs that good and honest Americans like YOU will not stand by as a rogue, politicized Democrat attorney general tries to destroy the life of an INNOCENT man all for defending our 45th and 47th President, I’m humbly asking for your support to help raise the $200,000 needed for my new defense trust to finally WIN the battle for my freedom and justice. The Trump administration is holding tens of thousands of people in ICE detention centers across the country in cruel, inhumane, and potentially deadly conditions.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2103%2E791427%2E_E8CNo)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4921?t=2&akid=2103%2E791427%2E_E8CNo)
Friend — The Trump administration is holding tens of thousands of people in ICE detention centers across the country in cruel, inhumane, and potentially deadly conditions.
Inadequate food and water, medical neglect and lack of access to care, cramped and over-crowded cells and holding areas, hard concrete for sleeping, mold and insect infestations, and limited access to legal counsel have become the status quo under Trump and DHS Secretary Kristi Noem’s policy of mass detention.
Many of the people stuck in these detention centers are legal residents, visa- holders, asylum-seekers, refugees, or even US citizens — folks who were following the law and still found themselves being held in detention by this administration for the sake of cruelty and intimidation alone.
Just recently we shared a story about legal refugees in Minnesota being randomly detained and shipped off to detention in Texas, only to have their refugee status confirmed and be released onto the street days later.
And to make matters worse, every new detention center is a money-making opportunity for for-profit prison companies. **The whole thing is morally repugnant.**
Make no mistake, we are being ruled by cruel, heartless people who have completely trashed our American values of compassion, justice, and fairness. We have an obligation to defeat the MAGA far-right for the sake of the very soul and future of this country.
That starts with taking back the House and Senate this November so we can begin deep oversight of the Trump administration’s immigration regime and pursue real changes to these inhumane policies.

And when the topic turned to economic development, I said something that I've believed for a long time: **Billionaires don't deserve a tax break over working Wisconsin families.** Deep down, I think most of us know that this is true. Trickle-down economics — the theory that granting tax cuts to the wealthiest will stimulate broader economic growth — has not proven effective. name: Del. Elizabeth Guzman

body:
| | | Dear Friend,

As the 2026 Virginia General Assembly has hit cross-over all House bills must have passed out of the chamber in order to be considered by the Senate. The House passed more than 849 bills 84% of which were bipartisan. I am so proud to have delivered on what we promised. I want to update you on our progress at the halfway point of this legislative session in Richmond.
_I introduced 15 bills into the House, 12 of which passed and are heading over to the Senate!___
* * *
**I am SO proud to update the status on my bills as they head over to the Senate:**

**HB 413 passed the House via Block Vote (97‐Y 0‐N 0‐A)**
HB 413 aims to address the shrinking Certified Nurse Aid (CNA) workforce by providing an alternative pathway to certification, allowing high school students to prepare for and obtain certification as a certified nurse aid (CNA). This bill addresses a critical healthcare professional shortage, and provides public students with a clear, affordable, and valuable pathway to healthcare careers and beyond.

**HB 414 passed House (79‐Y 19‐N 0‐A)**
HB414 aims to address the current barriers that college students face in obtaining the Virginia Tuition Assistance Grant. Under current law, a male student in Virginia is denied access to state grants if he does not register with the Selective Service. If denied, students can lose up to $5,250 in state aid for higher education. With college tuition rising, it is paramount that we take the necessary measures to ensure that all students have access to an affordable education.

This bill repeals the eligibility requirement to register with the Selective Service to receive state grants. Repealing this requirement reduces barriers for all students and aligns with current Federal Standards as of 2021 under the FAFSA Simplification Act. This bill also ensures every college student who applies for FAFSA is eligible for state grants, such as the Virginia Tuition Assistance Grant. This bill lowers barriers to higher education, saves students money, and keeps Virginia among the best states for higher education.

**HB 416 passed the House (66‐Y 31‐N 0‐A)**
Under current statute, when school buses are used for county purposes, the county is required to get insurance coverage to lease the school division buses. While well-intentioned, this requirement has proven unworkable in practice.This bill addresses that problem by allowing localities to reimburse the school division for any insurance costs, or additional insurance costs, incurred as a result of county use of school buses. HB 416 ensures that school divisions remain financially whole and protected from claims, while also reducing administrative inefficiencies.

**HB 417 passed House Block Vote (97‐Y 0‐N 0‐A)**
Virginia has one of the largest veteran populations and is often cited as the best state for veterans. However, Virginia has a stricter eligibility policy for in-state tuition than other states. Currently, for a military dependent to qualify for in-state tuition their service member must file Virginia tax returns for 10 years during active service. In almost every other case in Virginia, dependents must wait two years to qualify for in-state tuition. This lack of uniformity makes it unfair for military families seeking to have their kids attend school in Virginia. HB 417 solves this by reducing the time requirement for dependents to qualify for in-state tuition from 10 years to four years.
This creates a much more attractive option for prospective college students seeking higher education in Virginia. By charging in-state tuition rather than out-of-state rates, students will be able to pursue college degrees while taking out fewer loans. This bill will ensure that the Commonwealth is the best place for veterans.

**HB 495 passed the House (62‐Y 34‐N 0‐A)**
School bus drivers are often the first adults schoolchildren see at the start of their school day. This means that bus drivers are also the first ones to see students who may be suffering from mental health crises or children who have special education needs. However, the same bus drivers are not always equipped to recognize or handle such crises. HB 495 aims to address this by requiring school boards to implement policies requiring each school bus driver to complete mental health awareness training. This program already exists for teachers and was expanded in 2025.
The training takes 8 hours, with two hours self-paced and the remaining six hours virtual. The program takes steps to identify mental health, recognizing the importance of early intervention and crisis management. Additionally, the Virginia Education Association supports this bill and believes that adding a bus driver module during workplace development will not significantly increase training time. This bill gives bus drivers the necessary resources to identify and help students in times of crises.

**HB 496 passed the House (74‐Y 23‐N 0‐A)** This bill authorizes a locality to include in its zoning ordinance provisions for (i) requiring proposed industrial and commercial facilities to submit annual water consumption estimates and (ii) consideration of water consumption from public resources when making rezoning and special use permit decisions related to such facilities. The bill stipulates that such estimates shall be publicly accessible in submitted applications.

**HB 497 passed House (71‐Y 26‐N 0‐A)**
This bill is about data, how decisions are being made, and ensures special education will be data-driven. Critical information on IEP issues, 504 numbers, and parental concerns are currently being siloed, which hinders a transparent and analytical view of systemic failures and evidence-informed decisions. In the Commonwealth, data collection varies from school division to school division, with no standardized data available for affected parents, whether online or otherwise. This bill aims to have every school division post the information on their respective websites and/or summarize annual public reports on collected data via the school board in order to ensure data is transparent for future evidence-based policy decisions.

**HB 955 passed the House (88‐Y 7‐N 0‐A)**
Virginia taxpayers and policymakers lack consistent, transparent data on who our public universities are serving, creating an information vacuum that fuels distrust and hinders evidence-based funding decisions. Public universities currently have student residency data available; however, it is often hard to decipher or buried in broad federal reports, making it difficult to have a clear comparative view of student enrollment trends. This data is important to the General Assembly so we can assess if public higher education institutions are completing their mission to serve Virginians first and to plan for current and future workforce needs.
HB 955 serves to solve this problem by requiring the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia to annually report student enrollment data. SCHEV would be required to annually report on the enrollment of students and their residency information at each public institution. The Council shall report this information to the General Assembly no later than February 1st of each year. This bill provides the transparency necessary to make sure the needs of Virginians seeking higher education are met.

**HB 957 passed the House Block Vote (96‐Y 0‐N 0‐A)**
This bill requires the Department of Education to direct each school board to encourage each public elementary and secondary school in the local division to promote or utilize the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline to address student bullying and cyberbullying.

One of the leading causes is bullying. In Virginia 46.7% of middle school students have reported experiencing at least one form of bullying, bullying on school property or cyberbullying.

**HB 1404 passed House (65‐Y 33‐N 0‐A)
**HB 1404 would grant governing bodies the authority to appoint a nonvoting student representative. This is a great way to involve youth in the legislative process. When young people feel their voices are heard, they are more likely to be engaged citizens. Local school boards in the Commonwealth that have adopted procedures to appoint student representatives have seen youth civic engagement increase during school board meetings.

**HB 1502 passed House (61‐Y 35‐N 0‐A)**
HB 1502 directs the Department of Environmental Quality to conduct a one-year study of all standby generators used by certain commercial facilities in the Commonwealth, including data centers and explore ways to address the pollution from such generators. Standby generators produce many harmful pollutants. These pollutants have been associated with cardiovascular and respiratory disease and emergency room visits for asthma, among other health effects. The study shall identify commercial facilities that use standby generators, identify the type of pollutants emitted, and analyze and describe the amount of pollutants from these standby generators. Virginians are working harder than ever, yet the dream of stable housing is slipping out of reach for too many. We’re fighting to change that. From tackling rising rents to increasing affordable supply, we are committed to bringing costs down for working families in VA.
* * *
