clean_body: | | | Dear Friend, As the 2026 Virginia General Assembly has hit cross-over all House bills must have passed out of the chamber in order to be considered by the Senate. The House passed more than 849 bills 84% of which were bipartisan. I am so proud to have delivered on what we promised. I want to update you on our progress at the halfway point of this legislative session in Richmond. I introduced 15 bills into the House, 12 of which passed and are heading over to the Senate! I am SO proud to update the status on my bills as they head over to the Senate: HB 413 passed the House via Block Vote (97‐Y 0‐N 0‐A) HB 413 aims to address the shrinking Certified Nurse Aid (CNA) workforce by providing an alternative pathway to certification, allowing high school students to prepare for and obtain certification as a certified nurse aid (CNA). This bill addresses a critical healthcare professional shortage, and provides public students with a clear, affordable, and valuable pathway to healthcare careers and beyond. HB 414 passed House (79‐Y 19‐N 0‐A) HB414 aims to address the current barriers that college students face in obtaining the Virginia Tuition Assistance Grant. Under current law, a male student in Virginia is denied access to state grants if he does not register with the Selective Service. If denied, students can lose up to $5,250 in state aid for higher education. With college tuition rising, it is paramount that we take the necessary measures to ensure that all students have access to an affordable education. This bill repeals the eligibility requirement to register with the Selective Service to receive state grants. Repealing this requirement reduces barriers for all students and aligns with current Federal Standards as of 2021 under the FAFSA Simplification Act. This bill also ensures every college student who applies for FAFSA is eligible for state grants, such as the Virginia Tuition Assistance Grant. This bill lowers barriers to higher education, saves students money, and keeps Virginia among the best states for higher education. HB 416 passed the House (66‐Y 31‐N 0‐A) Under current statute, when school buses are used for county purposes, the county is required to get insurance coverage to lease the school division buses. While well-intentioned, this requirement has proven unworkable in practice.This bill addresses that problem by allowing localities to reimburse the school division for any insurance costs, or additional insurance costs, incurred as a result of county use of school buses. HB 416 ensures that school divisions remain financially whole and protected from claims, while also reducing administrative inefficiencies. HB 417 passed House Block Vote (97‐Y 0‐N 0‐A) Virginia has one of the largest veteran populations and is often cited as the best state for veterans. However, Virginia has a stricter eligibility policy for in-state tuition than other states. Currently, for a military dependent to qualify for in-state tuition their service member must file Virginia tax returns for 10 years during active service. In almost every other case in Virginia, dependents must wait two years to qualify for in-state tuition. This lack of uniformity makes it unfair for military families seeking to have their kids attend school in Virginia. HB 417 solves this by reducing the time requirement for dependents to qualify for in-state tuition from 10 years to four years. This creates a much more attractive option for prospective college students seeking higher education in Virginia. By charging in-state tuition rather than out-of-state rates, students will be able to pursue college degrees while taking out fewer loans. This bill will ensure that the Commonwealth is the best place for veterans. HB 495 passed the House (62‐Y 34‐N 0‐A) School bus drivers are often the first adults schoolchildren see at the start of their school day. This means that bus drivers are also the first ones to see students who may be suffering from mental health crises or children who have special education needs. However, the same bus drivers are not always equipped to recognize or handle such crises. HB 495 aims to address this by requiring school boards to implement policies requiring each school bus driver to complete mental health awareness training. This program already exists for teachers and was expanded in 2025. The training takes 8 hours, with two hours self-paced and the remaining six hours virtual. The program takes steps to identify mental health, recognizing the importance of early intervention and crisis management. Additionally, the Virginia Education Association supports this bill and believes that adding a bus driver module during workplace development will not significantly increase training time. This bill gives bus drivers the necessary resources to identify and help students in times of crises. HB 496 passed the House (74‐Y 23‐N 0‐A) This bill authorizes a locality to include in its zoning ordinance provisions for (i) requiring proposed industrial and commercial facilities to submit annual water consumption estimates and (ii) consideration of water consumption from public resources when making rezoning and special use permit decisions related to such facilities. The bill stipulates that such estimates shall be publicly accessible in submitted applications. HB 497 passed House (71‐Y 26‐N 0‐A) This bill is about data, how decisions are being made, and ensures special education will be data-driven. Critical information on IEP issues, 504 numbers, and parental concerns are currently being siloed, which hinders a transparent and analytical view of systemic failures and evidence-informed decisions. In the Commonwealth, data collection varies from school division to school division, with no standardized data available for affected parents, whether online or otherwise. This bill aims to have every school division post the information on their respective websites and/or summarize annual public reports on collected data via the school board in order to ensure data is transparent for future evidence-based policy decisions. HB 955 passed the House (88‐Y 7‐N 0‐A) Virginia taxpayers and policymakers lack consistent, transparent data on who our public universities are serving, creating an information vacuum that fuels distrust and hinders evidence-based funding decisions. Public universities currently have student residency data available; however, it is often hard to decipher or buried in broad federal reports, making it difficult to have a clear comparative view of student enrollment trends. This data is important to the General Assembly so we can assess if public higher education institutions are completing their mission to serve Virginians first and to plan for current and future workforce needs. HB 955 serves to solve this problem by requiring the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia to annually report student enrollment data. SCHEV would be required to annually report on the enrollment of students and their residency information at each public institution. The Council shall report this information to the General Assembly no later than February 1st of each year. This bill provides the transparency necessary to make sure the needs of Virginians seeking higher education are met. HB 957 passed the House Block Vote (96‐Y 0‐N 0‐A) This bill requires the Department of Education to direct each school board to encourage each public elementary and secondary school in the local division to promote or utilize the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline to address student bullying and cyberbullying. One of the leading causes is bullying. In Virginia 46.7% of middle school students have reported experiencing at least one form of bullying, bullying on school property or cyberbullying. HB 1404 passed House (65‐Y 33‐N 0‐A) HB 1404 would grant governing bodies the authority to appoint a nonvoting student representative. This is a great way to involve youth in the legislative process. When young people feel their voices are heard, they are more likely to be engaged citizens. Local school boards in the Commonwealth that have adopted procedures to appoint student representatives have seen youth civic engagement increase during school board meetings. HB 1502 passed House (61‐Y 35‐N 0‐A) HB 1502 directs the Department of Environmental Quality to conduct a one-year study of all standby generators used by certain commercial facilities in the Commonwealth, including data centers and explore ways to address the pollution from such generators. Standby generators produce many harmful pollutants. These pollutants have been associated with cardiovascular and respiratory disease and emergency room visits for asthma, among other health effects. The study shall identify commercial facilities that use standby generators, identify the type of pollutants emitted, and analyze and describe the amount of pollutants from these standby generators. name: Rose For Congress
subject: From a War Economy to a Peace Economy
body:
I’m running for Congress to help move our country from a war economy to a peace economy

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=316524b5c6&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |
# From a War Economy to a Peace Economy
---
| | Dear friend,
In my previous email, I wrote about the dangerous drumbeat of war we’ve been hearing again.
Today, I want to talk about what we can build instead.
For decades, our political and economic system has been organized around maintaining U.S. hegemony through military force. That meant building a military no one could challenge - and an economy designed to sustain that power at all costs.
That’s what a **war economy** is.
It’s why such a massive share of our national budget goes to the Pentagon, and now to Homeland Security and its paramilitary arm, ICE. And why we’re told there “isn’t enough money” for healthcare, housing, education, or climate resilience.
But friends, it isn’t a budget problem. It’s a priorities problem. It’s a values problem.I’m running for Congress to help move our country from a **war economy to a peace economy** \- one that invests in life and well-being, not killing and destruction.
A peace economy means:
* **Healthcare for all** , so getting sick doesn’t mean going bankrupt
* **Affordable homes** , built by union labor
* **Education, trade schools, and paid apprenticeships** , so young people have real opportunities — not enlistment as a last resort
* **Climate resilience projects** that protect our towns from fires, floods, and drought
* **Full, lifelong care for seniors and veterans** , not empty promises or patriotic slogans

A peace economy means spending our shared resources on what actually helps people live with dignity instead of fueling human suffering at home and abroad.
Every dollar not spent on bombs is a dollar that can heal, house, teach, and protect.This is the **People–Peace–Planet** agenda I will fight for in Congress. It will take real political will. It will take all of us.
Here’s how you can help:
* Share this message with someone who feels discouraged or afraid
* [Volunteer with our campaign](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=5e816bcf2b&e=8c53948e4c) — every role matters
* [Contribute if you’re able](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=228ad97561&e=8c53948e4c), so we can keep building a people-powered movement

Together, we can reject endless war and choose a future where all of us can thrive.
With hope and determination,**Rose Penelope Yee** Candidate for Congress, CA-02People · Peace · Planet
**P.S.** Peace doesn’t happen by accident. It happens when ordinary people organize for it and refuse to accept that endless war is “normal.”

# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260223-1&t=1&akid=3177%2E587540%2EJU9W4T)
Steve Cohen has no idea what’s coming, Peter.
In Memphis, people are showing up, talking about the change they want to see in their district, and rallying around Justin J. Pearson’s campaign.
**I’m positive Justin can beat Steve Cohen in November.** But only if we give him the resources to take on a 10-term incumbent who’s been in office for almost two decades.
**[Will you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and Justin right now to help defeat Steve Cohen in this Democratic primary?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260223_1_cohen.kYJ6iA&refcode=em20260223-3177&amount=5&t=2&akid=3177%2E587540%2EJU9W4T)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260223_1_cohen.kYJ6iA&amount=5&refcode=em20260223-3177&t=3&akid=3177%2E587540%2EJU9W4T)**
Here’s what’s going on in Memphis:
On MLK Day, Justin was there at sunrise, first in line, marching with pastors and union leaders, meeting people where they are. One organizer even said, **“He shows up everywhere.”**
_Cohen didn’t even show._ And as Justin said that day, **“His absence _isn’t_ felt.”**
That contrast basically sums up the entire race.
Cohen is counting on the idea that Memphis will stick with the same old, same old. He’s trying to wave off this race as if it’s just noise — he’s even compared Justin entering the race to _Pearl Harbor_. That just shows how threatened he is and how out of touch he’s become. No one in Congress should have such a level of entitlement. Even when Cohen was asked in a recent interview why he was running for reelection the best answer he could give was “because it comes up every two years."
Meanwhile, State Rep. Justin J. Pearson is relentlessly organizing in church basements and community events, having real conversations with voters, and building real momentum in this campaign.
This isn’t just about one seat. It’s about whether Democrats are willing to stop settling for the status quo and start electing leaders who will fight like the house is on fire — _because it is._
**[So, can you donate $5 right now to help Justin J. Pearson beat Steve Cohen and bring new leadership to Congress?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260223_1_cohen.kYJ6iA&refcode=em20260223-3177&amount=5&t=4&akid=3177%2E587540%2EJU9W4T)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,
---
I want to share something most people never see. When a child is rescued from sex trafficking, the danger may be over... but the pain is not. **Their body is free.**
But their heart, mind, and spirit are often still trapped. Many have nowhere safe to go. No bed of their own.
No warm meal waiting.
No trusted adult to say,
**" You are safe now. You are loved."** This is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** was created after the success of the film _Sound of Freedom_ --to turn awareness into action.

Its mission is simple and urgent: **to stop the sale of God 's children** by supporting rescue, protection, and long-term healing for victims of trafficking. Every day, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** works with trusted partners to help ensure that rescued children are not forgotten.**Because rescue is not the end of a child 's story.** Children who have survived trafficking carry deep trauma--
fear, shame, confusion, and pain no child should ever know. **They need more than freedom alone.**
**They need healing.** And healing begins in a home. That is why one of the Foundation's key partners is the House Parent Project.
---
[ **Give a Child a Place To Go**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3684f2229eee495eb293f16e5fed554d&_e=3coFNuCxU1QcWon_DWUHiO5MPl9XAnlIGLiAcW7EVanjS1oTvEDf83c28TunpT3CTR9CYWx9DcJAeA2Mqo-8lG1mSLIs03QGqkD15Y7u_ZTJ8LuABPBBw3Tuv7nJWMVL45WwL_DILIc9VC1AgmCG7m3LnABgYpCfUIvs6fMOzc3LbFCp613ZKHGbNinDfH9jKBUyunMUB0Fjd0QQnBYb7UfonlcR5uSe1EXFsx0s9I2ymooFn1Lh8qQTEJJJxpR3mGN9-cmwdve4mPwr4YxIJNG8hPBvXTNDlUvkRdyNwcJVKyPyZGLkznsDQHxAFDLrTlOQjFOw7Vlqd9MIo2PctR3YuPJHEj_z0YCZZc-WbwxP_Rl8Q6GeEE2HLXLSdc3x7ZLPndqPy7hInFB1z9qkJM9dpistPtttIJ7hFaar75HyC897--Y6pKeTQ_8F2I22yxEvi4KcoffpM5qz-NcO6X_S4bLL0vEoELXj-ZKKlZFANlDncjItlAz3Iwbl5pyqTxwtVlKV0_zf6QGHJS3rVg_BEXi56biK03jJ9reVUtHSx4oq5DNcYZO-zcuquvVehx9yJ9DuH0Xl5HhOf9C7_UYQXiejwDN1em2l9RieAa6y3ENnKnLt91bM6roebt4iMFQtScECr21FtzWUMXCK-cLL8pBQBHd_RcIeIcnUiLvolbZg32KK1H2zNh0X87NyKSoVam7s6qEo5bI1DNcZN-tVztokAL1iuJPXsv3fKCWxJgcmTmiwR-S9ClneRAPk99iPiwDLrAFkm-nCLUboBw%3D%3D)

The House Parent Project is a nationwide network of **trauma-informed, faith-filled homes** created specifically for children rescued from sex trafficking who have _no place to go_.

It exists to answer one heartbreaking cry heard again and again after rescues: "I have no place to go." Through this partnership, rescued children are not sent back into uncertainty.

They are welcomed into safety--into homes where healing can finally begin. In these homes, dedicated house parents provide:
---
* Immediate safe shelter
* Nutritious meals and clean clothing
* Medical and trauma-informed mental-health care
* Secure transportation and protection
* And most of all--consistent, loving adults who pray, listen, and stay

---
These house parents provide more than a roof. **They create an environment where a child can finally sleep without fear. **
**Where nightmares begin to fade. **
**Where trust is slowly rebuilt. **One little girl told us the first night she stayed in her house parent's home was the first night she had ever slept through the night. **That is what your generosity makes possible.** When you give, you are helping place a rescued child into a home of restoration. Jesus said,
_" I was a stranger, and you welcomed me."_ When you support this work, you are welcoming a child who has been rescued from evil-- and reminding them that God has not abandoned them.
---

One survivor's story shows why this matters so deeply. Her name is **Theresa Flores**. Theresa was trafficked as a teenage honor student--

clean_body: Rescue saves lives--but healing needs a home | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend, I want to share something most people never see. When a child is rescued from sex trafficking, the danger may be over... but the pain is not. Their body is free. But their heart, mind, and spirit are often still trapped. Many have nowhere safe to go. No bed of their own. No warm meal waiting. No trusted adult to say, " You are safe now. You are loved." This is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. The Sound of Freedom Foundation was created after the success of the film Sound of Freedom --to turn awareness into action. Its mission is simple and urgent: to stop the sale of God 's children by supporting rescue, protection, and long-term healing for victims of trafficking. Every day, the Sound of Freedom Foundation works with trusted partners to help ensure that rescued children are not forgotten.Because rescue is not the end of a child 's story. Children who have survived trafficking carry deep trauma-- fear, shame, confusion, and pain no child should ever know. They need more than freedom alone. They need healing. And healing begins in a home. That is why one of the Foundation's key partners is the House Parent Project. The House Parent Project is a nationwide network of trauma-informed, faith-filled homes created specifically for children rescued from sex trafficking who have no place to go. It exists to answer one heartbreaking cry heard again and again after rescues: "I have no place to go." Through this partnership, rescued children are not sent back into uncertainty. They are welcomed into safety--into homes where healing can finally begin. In these homes, dedicated house parents provide: Immediate safe shelter Nutritious meals and clean clothing Medical and trauma-informed mental-health care Secure transportation and protection And most of all--consistent, loving adults who pray, listen, and stay These house parents provide more than a roof. They create an environment where a child can finally sleep without fear. Where nightmares begin to fade. Where trust is slowly rebuilt. One little girl told us the first night she stayed in her house parent's home was the first night she had ever slept through the night. That is what your generosity makes possible. When you give, you are helping place a rescued child into a home of restoration. Jesus said, " I was a stranger, and you welcomed me." When you support this work, you are welcoming a child who has been rescued from evil-- and reminding them that God has not abandoned them. One survivor's story shows why this matters so deeply. Her name is Theresa Flores. Theresa was trafficked as a teenage honor student-- right here in America. Hidden in plain sight. Living at home while being exploited at night. For years, she carried the trauma in silence. But God restored her voice. Today Theresa Flores is a nationally respected survivor advocate and educator who works alongside organizations like the Sound of Freedom Foundation to expose how trafficking happens--and how healing is possible. Her journey--from captivity to courage--is told in her book, The Slave Across the Street. In this deeply personal story, Theresa explains how children can be trafficked while living at home. She explains how trauma affects the body and soul... and how healing begins when survivors are surrounded by safety, care, and faith. As a thank-you, I would be honored to send you a copy of The Slave Across the Street with a gift of $60 or more --to help expand the House Parent Project and provide more safe homes for rescued children. Your generosity is not just funding rescue. It's providing a bed, a meal, a protector and a future. It 's helping a child believe they are worth saving. **Thank YOU for caring. Thank YOU for taking the time to see what happens after rescue. And thank you for believing that God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

_**by Lawrence Winnerman**_
The Supreme Court has ruled that Trump's tariffs were imposed without lawful authority. That is not a marginal technicality; it means the federal government collected money it did not have the legal right to collect.
Over the life of those tariffs, the government took in hundreds of billions of dollars in duties. And while the payments were made at the border by importers, economists were consistent from day one: roughly 90-95% of those costs were passed directly on to American consumers. Prices went up. Families absorbed the difference. That is how tariffs work.
Which means this is about real cash, from real people's wallets. If you divide the economic burden across households, it comes out to roughly $1,500 to $1,700 per family. The people who were told tariffs would punish China ended up paying for them at Target, at the grocery store, and at the hardware store.
Now the Court says the authority wasn't there.
So who gets the money back? Personally, I want my $1,700 back.
Twelve states--Oregon, Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, New Mexico, New York, and Vermont--sued over the legality of the tariffs. They were right to do so.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf71610c-3502-4c44-b932-f8957197ef8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.XgYWrdrmquVVJmgWKiIEs0ie341O-kOVIgT7LGFFOQo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=188942665)
* * *
Governors like JB Pritzker in Illinois have now sent letters demanding that roughly $8.6 billion be returned to Illinois families. Gavin Newsom has publicly demanded refunds for Californians. They are arguing, correctly, that their residents bore the economic harm.
At the same time, more than 1,800 refund cases have already been filed in the U.S. Court of International Trade by corporations seeking to recover the duties they paid at customs. Companies including Costco, Revlon, EssilorLuxottica, J.Crew, Illumina, Dole, Diageo, Prada, and Dolce & Gabbana are either in litigation or preparing to file. And that number will grow.
Here is the chaos no one wants to say out loud.
Corporations have the cleanest paperwork. They were the importers of record. They can show exactly what they paid. So legally, they are positioned first in line for refunds.
_But they already passed those costs along in higher prices._
If they get refunds and do not reduce prices or rebate consumers--and there is currently no mechanism forcing them to--they recover money that American families already reimbursed them for at the checkout counter.
Now layer in state claims. If California successfully recovers funds on behalf of its residents while California-based corporations also receive customs refunds, do Californians get double compensation while Nebraskans get nothing? If Illinois recovers billions, and corporations operating nationally recover separately, how is that reconciled? The federal government collected once. It cannot logically pay twice. But absent a coordinated national mechanism, that is exactly the kind of unevenness that could emerge.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf71610c-3502-4c44-b932-f8957197ef8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* * *
And all of this will be litigated for years. Standing battles. Pass-through arguments. Sovereign immunity questions. Appeals. Administrative recalculations. The cost of unwinding this mess will itself cost billions more in legal fees and bureaucratic overhead. Money we do not have. Money that could have been used for actual infrastructure, healthcare, housing relief--anything real.
This was not an unavoidable crisis measure. It was a discretionary gamble. Economists warned it was reckless. Trade lawyers warned that the statutory footing was shaky. It was sold as strength. It turned out to be a self-inflicted wound.
American consumers are already stretched thin. Inflation is not theoretical. Affordability is not partisan. Families feel it every week. And now we are told the money was taken unlawfully -- but the path to getting it back is murky, unequal, and likely to favor the entities best equipped to navigate federal courts.
That is infuriating.
It should be infuriating.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf71610c-3502-4c44-b932-f8957197ef8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
In 2009, the Tea Party rose up over the perception that ordinary Americans were paying for elite mistakes. Whether you agreed with that movement or not, the emotional catalyst was economic unfairness. What we are looking at now is far clearer. A bad policy choice was made. The courts say it exceeded legal authority. The costs landed overwhelmingly on consumers. And the refund structure is tilted toward corporations.
This is the moment for a new kind of populist demand.
This is not performative outrage, or a culture-war distraction. It's a single, simple civic insistence: **Return the money to the people who paid it.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf71610c-3502-4c44-b932-f8957197ef8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Congress must create a consumer refund mechanism before a single corporate check goes out the door. If corporations receive refunds, there must be a statutory requirement that those funds be passed through proportionally to consumers. If states recover funds, those funds must be distributed equitably across residents, not captured for general budgets. There must be transparency. There must be a uniform national framework. And there must be accountability for the administrative costs of this debacle.
Because otherwise, the average American family will once again pay for a policy failure twice -- once at the register and again through the tax dollars required to unwind it.
There's a scene in _Better Off Dead_ where a paperboy relentlessly chases John Cusack for two dollars. It's absurd. It's funny. _But the joke works because the debt is real_.
That's where we are.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf71610c-3502-4c44-b932-f8957197ef8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The amount isn't two dollars. It's closer to $1,700 per household. And millions of Americans are looking at Washington and thinking the same thing:
**We want our money back.**
If this administration and this Congress don't build a fair, transparent refund system, they shouldn't be surprised when voters organize around that single demand. Not as a partisan slogan. As a civic reckoning.
Because this wasn't just bad policy.
It was an unnecessary, reckless, self-inflicted wound.
And the people who paid for it--us--deserve restitution.

And, a year later, what I shared that night feels just as relevant today. **Empathy is still key to meeting the moment we’re living through. And, yes, “woke” still means you give a damn about other people.** Authoritarians like Donald Trump wield “woke” like a slur because they know that when we answer empathy’s call to organize against them, we prove we’re more powerful. _We prove we’re stronger than fear. We prove we can win._ They want us to believe caring is a weakness. That looking out for one another is something to mock. But caring is exactly why ordinary people across this country are rising up to defend loved ones, neighbors, and complete strangers alike. The documentary moment we were in last year hasn’t paused. We haven’t gotten a moment of rest or rehearsal or intermission. And the stakes have only grown higher. Like the orchestrators of McCarthyism’s hysteria, too many of our leaders today work to silence truth for their own gain. One clear example: the Trump EPA’s recent decision to reverse the 2009 Endangerment Finding is one of the administration’s most aggressively anti-science moves yet, and one that puts real lives at risk. When leaders reject science and dismiss harm, what they’re really rejecting is empathy and the responsibility we have to protect one another. **Tomorrow, when Donald Trump delivers his State of the Union, that contrast will be on full display. We need to show everyone watching that we’re ready to fight back against his agenda of fear and cruelty — and that the strength of our movement cannot be underestimated.** **[This is still a time for bravery instead of isolation. A time to elect bold climate champions, who will stand up to Trump and Big Oil, and who will put people over profit every time. body:
Trump wants to nationalize our elections. I’m not letting him.

| |
---
Friend, Donald Trump is threatening to "nationalize" our local voting process and deploy federal agents to polling places for our 2026 elections. This is absurd and a clear violation of what is foundational to being American. Voters should never have to fear harassment or violence from agents of their own government—in or out of the voting booth. And that's why I’m rolling out my Election Integrity Agenda. It’s a roadmap to ensure that the will of the people — not the will of the White House — determines our leaders. My plan is simple:
* Prohibit federal agents and the military from polling places
* Ban federal funds from being used to "nationalize" or manipulate elections
* Provide real legal protections for poll workers against MAGA intimidation
* Demand a Commitment to the Peaceful Transfer of Power from the Trump administration

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

**Use Gold for Tax-Efficient Growth and Legacy Planning**

Gold is treated differently under IRS rules. With the right structure, you can turn a potential tax drag into a wealth-preservation tool.

* **Tax-deferred or tax-free growth with a Gold IRA.** Traditional for pre-tax and deferred growth. Roth for tax-free qualified withdrawals.
* **Estate step-up in basis.** Heirs receive a reset cost basis at date of death. This can eliminate lifetime capital gains on inherited metal.
* **Strategic gifting.** Shift future gains to family members in lower brackets within annual gifting limits.
* **Hold for the long haul.** No sale means no taxable event. Ideal for preservation-first investors.
* **Tax-loss harvesting.** Offset gains elsewhere when markets turn against you.

**Avoid the 28 percent Collectibles Rate**

# [We don't quit: Michigan manufacturing and the fight ahead](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=188924085&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg4OTI0MDg1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzE4ODU5MDQsImV4cCI6MTc3NDQ3NzkwNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.gEE-eJ3EWy_a2divjiunEGLUnYRmi05e1yUGr0RscXk)
### This is grit.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Feb 23
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..d5SFGeSIGzzZK3bH8l6tlPbJ4H_GiRod5Xur9JdZUXo?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)

---

Let me tell you something I know for certain: **Manufacturing made Michigan - **_**and Michigan made me.**_
I was born and raised in Michigan, and I've been surrounded by this industry my whole life. From the shop floors to the shipping docks, from Auburn Hills to Grand Rapids, we're not just talking about a 9 to 5 job - we're talking about a way of life. About a career you can raise a family on. About pride in building something with your own two hands. About what it means to be from Michigan.
It's not always been easy. There have always been people, pundits, and politicians who have doubted Michigan manufacturing. That's not me - and that's not the hardworking people of Michigan. We don't walk away from challenges. **We rise to meet them.**
To the doubters, I say: Come see Michigan. Come walk the floor of an auto plant. Talk to the folks who never gave up on Michigan manufacturing, who've trained the next generation with calloused hands and open hearts. **This is the Michigan way: Grease, grit, and hard work.**_**It 's who we are.**_
And yes, we're in a tough moment. The Trump administration's tariffs put an incredible strain on our auto industry. Supply chains are still recovering. And overseas competition is taking aim at American-made goods. That's why our manufacturing sector deserves an advocate in the U.S. Senate.
I've spent my career fighting for this state and this industry. I helped lead the auto rescue under President Obama in 2008 - when people were writing Detroit off, we rolled up our sleeves and helped save over 200,000 jobs.
In Congress, I've worked to bring manufacturing jobs back to Michigan and strengthen workforce training programs. Always side by side with union workers. Always pushing for legislation that will help Michiganders thrive.
We are a state whose economy is still driven centrally by manufacturing. That's not a flaw - it's a strength. There's pride in the work, pride in the skilled workforce, and pride in knowing that we're building the future, brick by brick.
When I travel across Michigan, from Detroit to Flint, from Lansing to Traverse City, I see that pride. There's a sense of unity. We came back. **That 's Michigan grit**.
That's why I'm running for Senate. To be a champion for Michigan manufacturing. To fight like hell for our working families. And to make sure our kids grow up in a state that builds the future.
So if you believe, like I do, that Michigan manufacturing is worth fighting for, I hope you'll consider making a contribution to support this campaign.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/27c2b005-28e8-419f-963e-26fd8adee7bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We've got a long road ahead - but we're Michigan. Grit is what we do. We build. We fight. We never give up.
Let's do it together.
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

The 2026 Winter Olympics may be over, but there is still one more set of medals to award!**We asked you to pick your favorite redwood hikes** —the most unforgettable and incredible trails and forests that hold a special place in your heart. We’ve tallied your votes, and the results are in.
---
Here are your medalists for Best Redwood Hike!
---
| |
---
| **Bronze: Mariposa Grove**
---
Kicking things off on the podium is the bronze medal winner: Mariposa Grove (Yosemite). This iconic grove inspired our nation’s conversation movement, and its towering giant sequoias have been the site of precious memories across generations. Here’s what you had to say:
---
_“It is always a spiritual feeling when I visit.”_ _“Each time I see them, I feel more wonder in my heart for all my favorite trees. I can hardly wait until I arrive and once I'm there I never want to leave.”_
---
| |
---
| **Silver: Muir Woods**
---
In a photo finish, Muir Woods secured the silver medal. Whether you’ve been to Muir Woods hundreds of times or only once, these old-growth trees come to mind for so many when remembering their favorite moments in the redwoods:
---
_“My parents took my four siblings and I to San Francisco in the summer. We would always visit Muir Woods. From the peaceful quiet, to the trees, to hiking the wonderful trails. It was all so beautiful.”_
---
| |
---
| **Gold: Grove of Titans**
---
In a league of its own and taking the gold medal is the Grove of Titans (Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park), a northern treasure home to some of the largest coast redwoods on earth. With your support, Save the Redwoods helped preserve this grove with investments in recreational, educational, and interpretive infrastructure along Mill Creek Trail to ensure the grove is enjoyed responsibly by many for years to come. If you haven’t visited yet, see what your fellow judges had to say:
---
_"Simply breathtaking beauty.”_ _“As an outdoor education instructor, I keep coming back here with my students because it fills them with awe!”_
---

body:
Republicans lied about health care.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=625%2E124072%2E2M1ij_)
Imagine this, Peter: You trip on the stairs and land badly on an ankle. You think it’s a sprain — but it’s just not healing. You know you should go to the doctor. You know an X-ray is in the cards. _But you don’t have health care coverage. You’d have to pay out of pocket. And if you do that, you might not be able to pay the rent._ Peter, one accident, one trip to the doctor — it should never break the bank. That’s why leaders like Roy Cooper have fought so hard for so long to expand access to the affordable health care coverage that people deserve, including by getting a bipartisan deal on Medicaid Expansion for more than 700,000 North Carolinians. Now, millions of Americans will lose coverage under the GOP’s plan. **Look, Republicans in Washington swore up and down that they wouldn’t mess with our health care._They lied._ And we’re the ones who’ll bear the burden.** **[We have to stand up and fight for our RIGHT to health care, Peter. We’re looking for 1,000 signatures today to tell Republicans to take their hands off our health care. * * *
FBI Director Kash Patel managed to embarrass not just himself, but the entire United States yesterday by using taxpayer dollars to fly a private jet to Milan to celebrate with the men's hockey team.
And here's the thing: I was genuinely excited to watch that game. I woke up early, grabbed coffee and donuts for my family, parked myself on the couch, and watched. It was awesome. Every time the American goalie shut down a Canadian shot, it was electric. You could feel how pumped everyone was -- on both sides. It was one of those rare, exciting sports moments that reminds you why sports matter in bringing people together.
And then, during a moment meant to unify the country, this administration inserted itself into it once again. Because under this administration, nothing is allowed to simply belong to the public. Every moment has to orbit them.
There are two things I want to drill into in this rant:
First, under this administration, everything has to be political. Everything.
Second, the smug, shameless abuse of power and taxpayer dollars.
On the first point, I'm exhausted. I'm sick and tired of every single thing in this country turning into a political circus. I'm sick of Donald Trump and his administration being shoved into every space, every event, every moment that's supposed to belong to the public. And in this case, it belonged to the US Men's Hockey Team. It's aggressively frustrating.
Look at the Super Bowl halftime show a few weeks ago. The entire conservative movement lost its mind because Bad Bunny -- who they don't consider a "real American" because he's a US citizen from Puerto Rico -- performed. So what did they do? They created their own "pro-America" halftime show sponsored by Turning Point USA. And the best they could come up with was Kid Rock. The same loser they've been trotting out for two decades.
It was embarrassing. Something that should have been unifying -- the Super Bowl, a gold medal, a national sports moment -- got dragged into another manufactured culture war. And that's not an accident. The division comes from people who benefit from division. They want us at each other's throats. They want an Olympic gold or a championship game -- moments they had absolutely no hand in -- to be credited to them, their movement, or Donald Trump's presidency. They want every celebration to become another excuse for us to scream at one another.
It's the same playbook every time: take something that belongs to everyone, turn it into a loyalty test, and center yourselves in it.
And while the outrage machine hums, real accountability stalls.
These are the same influencers out there defending Jeffrey Epstein, running interference for Kash Patel during this cover-up, carrying water for billionaires while the middle class gets stripped for parts.
The top 1% of the 1% now has more wealth than the entire middle class, while the Epstein class gets away with abusing kids. And instead of focusing on that, they want you furious that Bad Bunny spoke Spanish.
Who the hell cares?
Regular people don't care. We want to enjoy our lives. We want to sit on the couch, eat donuts, cheer for our team, and feel connected to something bigger than politics. But they can't allow that. They need the outrage machine running 24/7 because if we're exhausted and distracted, we're not paying attention.
But distraction is the point. If you're exhausted and fighting your neighbor, you're not paying attention to who's protecting whom, and you're less likely to realize that the commonalities you and your neighbor share far outweigh your differences at the ballot box.
* * *

* * *
Now the second point: Kash Patel is an embarrassment to the FBI.
He has no business being in that job. He's not a workhorse -- he's a show horse.
He's an influencer running one of the most powerful law enforcement agencies in the world, and he's running it like it's a podcast brand. Clicks over cases. Optics over outcomes. Visibility over vigilance.
When news broke about the assassination of Charlie Kirk, Patel didn't project steadiness -- he projected himself. He tweeted repeatedly about catching the suspect, inserting his name into an active investigation.
Real law enforcement professionals protect cases. They don't perform them. And they don't insult the dedicated FBI investigators doing the actual work with their ego.
That's the problem. We now have people in powerful national security positions who built their brands on podcasts, outrage, and flattery in lieu of competence. Loyalty has become the qualification and attention the currency.
Patel knows Trump won't fire him. He's protecting on the Epstein files. Because he knows that when loyalty is the job requirement, accountability loses its place.
So yes, he acts like someone untouchable. He hops on a taxpayer-funded jet and flies to Milan to chug beer with Olympians -- people who actually earned their moment -- and makes himself part of the frame.
I'm not even mad at the players. Most of them probably had no idea who he was or that he was going to show up in their locker room. To them, he was just another guy trying to climb into the celebration -- until he FaceTimed the president, who somehow managed to insult the women's hockey team in the process.
And that's the point.
This isn't about hockey. It's about power -- and what happens when the people entrusted with it treat it like a stage.
This administration tells you the country is broke.
No money for cancer research.
No money for school lunches.
No money for Medicare.
No money for Medicaid.
We're told austerity is necessary. Sacrifice is patriotic.
But there's always money for a private jet.
Every time that jet takes off, it costs roughly $15,000 just to get airborne -- before you factor in flight time, security, and luxury hotels. And I promise you he wasn't at a La Quinta.
And it's not just him. Kristi Noem's private jet scandal. The absurd makeup room at the Pentagon so Pete Hegseth can do TV hits. Hanging fascist-looking signs of Trump's ugly mug in front of the DOJ. The ballroom. The endless stream of vanity projects and political retribution campaigns. It's exhausting.
Nothing happening in Donald Trump's Washington is about improving your life. It's about centering themselves in every experience. Kash Patel is living his best life on your dime. And he's doing nothing to keep you safe.
He promised to work tirelessly to bring Nancy Guthrie home. Funny -- he looked pretty energized chugging beers in Milan. I don't see him taking down drug traffickers. I don't see him dismantling terrorist networks. I don't see him going after the Epstein class who abuse children. I see him protecting Donald Trump.
He should be under investigation for lying to Congress, by the way. He won't be -- because he's betting on a pardon when this is all over. Loyalty buys protection. That's the game.
At the end of the day, yes -- this is about a guy going to a hockey game.
But it matters because it's never just the hockey game. It's the constant need to insert themselves into everything. To exhaust us. To normalize the abuse. To make corruption feel acceptable.
They abuse taxpayer dollars. They abuse their power. They abuse the trust placed in them.
It's disgusting. It's everything wrong with Donald Trump's Washington.
And when November comes, and the reckoning arrives, I hope every Democrat who takes power in 2027 is ready to launch full, brutal investigations and expose exactly who these people are.
I, for one, cannot fucking wait.

| | We are drifting toward a world where the government and billion-dollar corporations track, scan, and profile us without real oversight or accountability. Right now, Homeland Security has been sending sweeping subpoenas to social media companies, demanding information on accounts that track or even comment on ICE activity. At the same time, ICE is using facial recognition technology to identify and target people, often without transparency or meaningful safeguards. **That is a direct threat to our privacy and our constitutional rights.** **That's why I co-led the ICE Out of Our Faces Act,** because no one should have their face scanned and stored in a government database simply for living their life. And it's not just the government. Giant corporations are deploying "surveillance pricing," using invasive data tracking to figure out the absolute highest price they can squeeze out of you at the grocery store or online checkout. **It's predatory, and I'm fighting to ban this sinister technology. I joined Senator Luján to introduce the Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act of 2026,** which prohibits companies from using surveillance pricing in grocery stores. Powerful interests love surveillance because it gives them control.**I believe in something different: power in the hands of people, not bureaucrats or billionaires.** [**If you believe your face, your data, and your voice belong to you, not the government and not corporate profiteers, I need you with me. Right now, Homeland Security has been sending sweeping subpoenas to social media companies, demanding information on accounts that track or even comment on ICE activity. At the same time, ICE is using facial recognition technology to identify and target people, often without transparency or meaningful safeguards. That is a direct threat to our privacy and our constitutional rights. That's why I co-led the ICE Out of Our Faces Act, because no one should have their face scanned and stored in a government database simply for living their life. And it's not just the government. Giant corporations are deploying "surveillance pricing," using invasive data tracking to figure out the absolute highest price they can squeeze out of you at the grocery store or online checkout. It's predatory, and I'm fighting to ban this sinister technology. I joined Senator Luján to introduce the Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act of 2026, which prohibits companies from using surveillance pricing in grocery stores. name: Virginians For Fair Elections
subject: Misinformation could win unless we act now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Virginians for Fair Elections
body:
A new poll shows what happens when voters haven’t heard the facts yet.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260223-226&t=1&akid=226%2E12592%2EwEcUBo)
We always knew this fight would require real work.
As you know, Governor Spanberger signed off on new congressional district maps last week that would likely result in Democrats winning 10 of the 11 House seats in Virginia.
But a new poll -- fielded before our campaign had fully ramped up -- shows what happens when voters haven’t heard the facts yet. Right now, 52% of Virginians would vote NO on the Fair Elections Amendment which would implement these maps.
When voters are misinformed on what constitutional amendments do, they start behind. That’s not unusual. What matters is what happens next.
**That’s exactly why Virginians for Fair Elections was created.**
Across the Commonwealth, MAGA-aligned voices and partisan operatives are flooding the airwaves with confusion, half-truths, and fear. And when voters believe misinformation, even an issue grounded in transparency and fairness can fall behind.
The Fair Elections amendment ensures Virginians see the maps, understand them, and decide for themselves whether or not they should be implemented. We know that’s the right way to do politics.
But here’s the truth we can’t ignore: **We wouldn’t win if the vote were held today.**
That’s because confusion and bad information are running rampant in Virginia. And that’s why we must get accurate information in front of voters _right now._
We urgently need your help today. **[Can you chip in whatever you can to help us:](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260223_2.z-pnGU&amount=3&refcode=20260223-226&t=2&akid=226%2E12592%2EwEcUBo)**
* Counter misinformation with voter education
* Reach Virginians with straightforward explanations of what the amendment _really_ does
* Ensure this campaign reflects the will of the people, not the loudest noise?

**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260223_2.z-pnGU&amount=3&refcode=20260223-226&t=21&akid=226%2E12592%2EwEcUBo)**
We can still turn this around. But we need resources -- and with just 57 days until our election -- we need them today. Thank you for helping ensure democracy prevails over chaos in Virginia.
-- Virginians for Fair Elections

[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_vafe_2026_footer?refcode=em&t=22&refcode2=226_12592_wEcUBo&akid=226%2E12592%2EwEcUBo)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

name: Tim Walz
subject: This is unamerican
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.
I need your help in this fight. If you’re able, please split a donation between our Legal Defense fund and Outrage then Action PAC and make sure we can continue to stand up to Donald Trump and his DOJ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp_2026_dga?refcode=partner_ms_tw_em_022026_realtexaspac]

subject: These judges wouldn’t know “justice” if it hit them in the face →

body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260223-61200&t=1001&akid=61200%2E1407376%2ERI9ipj ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260223-61200&t=1002&akid=61200%2E1407376%2ERI9ipj ]Demand Justice PAC

In the next few weeks, the Senate will hold hearings for yet another round
of Trump’s cronies.

These are judges nominated for lifetime seats who bow to Trump instead of
the law. Judges who refuse to recognize the results of the 2020 election,
and who excuse January 6. Judges who wouldn’t know “justice” if it hit
them in the face.

And once again... some Senate Democrats are just going to sit there and nod
along.

The same Senators who warn about authoritarianism one day and quietly roll
out the red carpet for Trump’s partisan hacks the next.

It’s absurd. And it’s 100% preventable.

This is the moment for Senate Democrats to stand up and do their job. No
more speeches. No more excuses. It’s time to vote NO on any nominee whose
loyalty lies with Trump, not the Constitution.

We’re turning up the heat and making sure every Democrat knows the public

Hi, it's Raja. With less than a month until Election Day, I wanted to give you an update from the campaign trail.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22249969-b839-42a4-836a-10acc1b6dbda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you've tried to reach me lately, there's a good chance I was in my "mobile office" somewhere between Rockford and Carbondale. I've been on the road constantly -- driving from town to town, county to county, listening to the people who make this state what it is.
Because of my Central Illinois roots, I've made it a priority to spend as much time as possible outside of Chicagoland, showing up in every region and hearing directly from the people who call it home.
**As a son of Peoria, I 've never forgotten where I come from.** I launched this campaign outside the house where I was raised because that community shaped me -- and because too often, communities like the one I grew up in get left out of the conversation in Washington.
Since then, my team and I have criss-crossed Illinois nonstop -- from the Quad Cities to Bloomington, from Peoria to Springfield, from Metro East to Carbondale (Go Salukis!). Just last month alone, I was in East St. Louis, Champaign, Normal, Moline, and Rockford, sitting down face-to-face with folks to hear about the challenges they're facing and the opportunities they want to see.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22249969-b839-42a4-836a-10acc1b6dbda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I've walked through manufacturing plants, visited safety-net hospitals, sat down with union workers, teachers, healthcare professionals, small business owners, and community leaders. I've listened more than I've talked. And everywhere I go in Illinois, I hear the same thing:****_People want a government that works for everyone -- one that's there for those fighting to make it, not just those who already have it made._
**That 's what this campaign is about.**
So in these final weeks, we're scaling up -- putting more organizers on the ground, activating volunteers in every region, expanding our outreach online - to ensure every Illinoisan hears our message.
Right now, a shady Super PAC is blanketing the air and spending millions against us, so the best way we can fight back is by having a field team on the ground to talk with voters, hand out literature, and push GOTV efforts. But it's also incredibly expensive.
**[If you can afford it, will you donate a few dollars to my campaign to supply our on-the-ground team with anything they may need to connect with Illinoisans in every corner of our state?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22249969-b839-42a4-836a-10acc1b6dbda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE NOW >>](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22249969-b839-42a4-836a-10acc1b6dbda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Best,
Raja Krishnamoorthi

| | ******Friend,** This is a message of **real gratitude**. If you are reading this, you are one of the people who has already stepped up for this campaign. You have chipped in. You have shared our message. You have believed in something different. I want you to know how much that means to me. I am **not a polished Washington insider**. I am a **manufacturing engineer**. A **small business owner**. A **working dad**. I built this campaign the same way I built my career - from the shop floor up. And because of you, we have proven something important. **Grassroots energy is real.**
**Working people are hungry for change.**
**The old political playbook is breaking.** But here is the hard truth. We are watching a **steady erosion of our constitutional freedoms**. We are seeing Republican forces consolidate power, push legislative agendas that undermine democratic norms, and stack cash in unprecedented ways to influence everything from Capitol Hill to statehouses. And while we fight hard, they are **raising and stockpiling staggering sums of money**. The Republican National Committee has **vastly outpaced Democrats in fundraising ahead of these critical midterm elections** , holding a nearly **$100 million advantage in cash on hand** as early FEC filings show. That cash cushion gives them power to flood battleground districts with ads, data, field operations, and influence. That’s money grassroots campaigns simply _cannot ignore_ \- and money we must _raise now, before it is too late._ We **cannot** head into one of the most consequential elections of our lifetime **low on cash**. Not when corporate-aligned candidates are stacking up six-figure checks from industry insiders.
Not when super PAC networks are ready to pour outside money into districts like **Colorado 04**.
Not when the political establishment is betting grassroots campaigns like ours will run out of gas. This race is bigger than one district. It is about whether working-class, independent voices can actually compete in a system built for the well-connected. If we walk into this election underfunded, we give the advantage back to the same political machine that has failed working families for decades. I refuse to do that. I am asking you, as someone who **understands what is at stake nationally** , to help us close the gap now. **Early investment determines whether campaigns like ours break through or get buried.** If you can step up again - even in a small way - it makes a real difference.
We do not have **corporate bundlers**.
We **have people**. And I am **deeply grateful** for every single one of you. We are building something honest. But **honesty alone doesn’t pay for voter outreach, organizing, media placement, and field operations.** Resources matter. Momentum matters. Infrastructure matters. Help us prove that a **people-powered campaign can win in this climate**. Chip in if you can. Stand with us if you believe in this mission. **We are not running to manage the system.**

subject: I stood up to ICE. Now I’m facing calls for impeachment.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-bellows?refcode=2620223em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-bellows?refcode=2620223em]
This is Shenna Bellows reaching out with some urgent news:
Republicans in the legislature are now threatening to bring impeachment proceedings against me – because I stood up to ICE.
Before I go any further, will you chip in $20 – split between my campaign and Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read – to help power our campaign for Governor and fight back against these latest attacks right now?
Last month, I made the call – as Maine’s Secretary of State – to pause the issuance of undercover license plates to federal agencies. Because I will not allow Maine to be complicit in secretive operations that could endanger our neighbors.
Across the nation, we’ve seen ICE’s abuse and lawlessness in broad daylight, with families torn apart and communities living in fear. I refuse to look the other way – and I refuse to let Maine be used as a tool for that kind of harm.
As Secretary of State, I have a duty to ensure state resources aren’t misused or abused. So I acted.
Now, Republicans are trying to punish me by bringing impeachment proceedings against me.
I won’t back down. But I need your help.
Will you chip in $20 right now – split between my campaign and Tobias Read – to help us stand up to these attacks and keep fighting for a Maine where everyone’s rights are protected? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-bellows?refcode=2620223em]

In a moment, I’m going to ask you to [**_split a donation between Maggie Hassan and my campaign for U.S. Senate to help us win this fight for our future._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125988716/603554372/-939871488?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.02.23_Mary-Peltola-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjMyZGJlYi0wYjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6IPd__Z-g73kZfSXPvN5r35YITk5DjNu_xOji2ZAd8E=)

But first, let me explain why your support is so important using one of my favorite Alaska winter activities – _and our official state sport!_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125988717/603554373/-939871488?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.02.23_Mary-Peltola-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjMyZGJlYi0wYjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6IPd__Z-g73kZfSXPvN5r35YITk5DjNu_xOji2ZAd8E=) When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid.

But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system.

That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.

But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for!

_So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in:_

**As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this.**

It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC.

Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together.

So I’m asking:

[**_Split a donation of $10, or whatever you can, between my campaign and Maggie Hassan to help us build on our grassroots momentum. Alaska’s Senate race will be one of the most competitive in the nation, so please chip in to help us keep moving._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125988718/603554374/-939871488?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.02.23_Mary-Peltola-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjMyZGJlYi0wYjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6IPd__Z-g73kZfSXPvN5r35YITk5DjNu_xOji2ZAd8E=) _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Mary Peltola and Maggie Hassan will go through immediately:_ | | [ DONATE $10 NOW >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125988719/603554375/-939871488?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.02.23_Mary-Peltola-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjMyZGJlYi0wYjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6IPd__Z-g73kZfSXPvN5r35YITk5DjNu_xOji2ZAd8E=)

body:
Sarah introduced bipartisan legislation to expand flexible, job-protected leave for working families.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2861%2E21716%2ERY3mzX)
Have you ever had to make the impossible choice between caring for a loved one and losing your job?
You shouldn’t have to. **Dignity means never having to choose between your job and your family.**
That is why Sarah introduced the Flexible Leave Act, a bipartisan piece of legislation that modernizes the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and expands access to flexible leave that works for real families in Delaware and across the country.
[**In a minute, we’ll explain exactly what this bill does and why it matters. But first, will you become a grassroots co-sponsor for the Flexible Leave Act?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260223-1-flexible-leave-act/?sourcecode=em20260223-2861&t=2&akid=2861%2E21716%2ERY3mzX)
**[Become a Co-sponsor](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260223-1-flexible-leave-act/?sourcecode=em20260223-2861&t=3&akid=2861%2E21716%2ERY3mzX)**
**Here’s the problem:**
Right now, under the FMLA, families needing to care for a child or a loved one face all-or-nothing choices. They are forced into “one-size-fits-all” rules that don’t understand how caregiving actually looks in real life.
**Here’s what this bill actually does:**
It allows parents to split their leave so they can rotate time at home with a new child. One parent stays at home, one works, and then they switch. This way, parents can care for their child longer without losing their jobs.
But this bill doesn’t just help new parents. If you need to take a parent or loved one to chemotherapy appointments, this bill helps you. If you need treatment or have to manage a chronic condition, this bill helps you, too.
The Flexible Leave Act cuts through the red tape so that workers and their families can use their leave in the way that serves them best – whether intermittently or on a reduced schedule.
**Sarah will never stop fighting for universal paid family and medical leave. But she’ll also never stop fighting to expand protections for workers right now.** That's why she introduced the Flexible Leave Act — building on her work at the state level and now at the federal level to build dignity for workers by modernizing the FMLA.
[**But we need your help to get this bill over the finish line. Your support shows Congress that people across the country want flexible leave for working people.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260223-1-flexible-leave-act/?sourcecode=em20260223-2861&t=4&akid=2861%2E21716%2ERY3mzX)
**[Add Your Name](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260223-1-flexible-leave-act/?sourcecode=em20260223-2861&t=5&akid=2861%2E21716%2ERY3mzX)**
Thank you. Every signature makes a difference.
Team Sarah McBride

Hey Peter! It's
Katie, Abdul's Finance Director.

We recently finalized our budget for the next stretch of this race —
basically, a roadmap that puts us in the strongest possible position to
win.

Our plan includes more organizing, more ads, and more events! All of which
costs a lot of $$$.

That brings me to why I’m writing this email.

As we finalized our plan, we realized there’s a gap in our budget. 😅

We debated scaling back. But in a primary this competitive, cutting even a
few town halls could mean missing a few hundred voters — and in August, a
few hundred votes could decide this race.

So, stressful as it was, we moved forward with our original plan.

Most campaigns in this position would just call up a corporate mega-donor
or a billionaire and ask them to write a six-figure check. Then, poof,
problem solved!

Our campaign is different. Abdul has never taken money from corporate
PACs, and never will. He’s fully relying on people like you.

subject: [Contact your Senator] Tell your Senators to vote NO on the SAVE Act
body:
We need to speak up against this harmful bill right now.
#
Last week, the SAVE Act passed in the House.**Now the Senate is expected to vote on it this week, and we need to speak up against this harmful bill right now.**
Republicans pioneering this bill are calling it “election security,” but our elections are already safe and secure. The SAVE Act is clearly another voter suppression tactic.
If passed, it would make it harder for eligible Americans to register and vote by requiring proof of citizenship with documents like a passport or birth certificate and by adding extra hurdles that create more confusion for eligible voters.
Millions of Americans do not have ready access to those documents. Roughly half of U.S. citizens do not have a passport. Millions do not have a paper copy of their birth certificate. And tens of millions of women who changed their names after marriage could face extra steps just to register.
And the new version of the SAVE Act that moved to the Senate would also restrict online and mail voter registration, mandate frequent voter roll purges, and create a narrow photo ID requirement. **The result would restrict _20 million voters_ , mainly low-income people of color, from voting.**
That is not safeguarding elections. It is hand-picking who does and who doesn’t vote.
**[Tell your Senators to vote NO on this anti-democratic bill and protect our voting rights.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22308?source=em20260223-1510&t=1&akid=1510%2E2118727%2EenT6-j)**
**[Email your U.S. Senators ➡️](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22308?source=em20260223-1510&t=2&akid=1510%2E2118727%2EenT6-j)**
Thank you for taking action today to defend our democracy.
In solidarity,
LeftNet

I'm writing to you today because I believe in fighting for what matters, and there's no one I trust more to fight for the issues we care about than my friend, Dr. Raul Ruiz. name: Delia Ramirez
subject: 212 candidates are supporting Block the Bombs.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Something important is happening across our country.

The Block the Bombs Act — legislation I introduced to stop U.S. bombs from
being sent to the Israeli government as it commits genocide against the
Palestinian people — is becoming a litmus test in Democratic primaries
nationwide.

Over 200 candidates across the US are now voicing their support of passing
it, because voters are demanding more than just empty statements about
"peace" while Congress continues to support weapons deals that make peace
impossible.

When I introduced this legislation last year, I was told to wait until it
was less risky for me. I was told we would be lucky if I get ten members
to sign onto the bill. But I knew that this issue couldn’t wait for a time
that was politically convenient. Palestinians needed action NOW.

I’m proud to say that today we have over 60 members of Congress signed on
as co-sponsors, with hundreds of candidates across the country pledging
their support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260223-2-dr.Bu871C&refcode=em20260223-37493&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37493%2E1203867%2Et3bpis ]Donate Today

That’s what the Block the Bombs Act is about. It’s not symbolic. It is a
direct challenge to the blank-check politics that have defined this issue
for decades.

This is what democracy looks like when it’s working.

We still have a long road ahead. The right-wing attacks are predictable,
and their pressure to make people fall in line is intense. But this moment
proves something powerful: when people refuse to look away from injustice,
when they demand that their representatives match their values, change
follows.

The question is no longer whether this issue matters. The question is who
will have the courage to meet it.

In Solidarity,

Delia
